title: Front-end Developer
original_description:
We are growing rapidly and constantly expanding our global contactless payment ecosystem. To support this momentum, we are looking for a passionate Front-end Developer to take ownership of designing, developing, and implementing applications for our cutting-edge Payter products.

You will be the crucial link that flawlessly bridges robust technology with user needs and business goals. In this role, you will specify, design, build, and test subsystems while contributing to the overall technological foundation of Payter. You will work closely with various disciplines to ensure our customers experience applications that not only work smoothly but look shiny across every device and environment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the front-end architecture and web applications for our innovative products.

  • Ensure a flawless user experience, collaborating closely with graphic designers and other teams so that applications run perfectly and look visually stunning on all devices and environments.

  • Specify, design, build, and test (sub)systems within the boundaries of system specifications, project timelines, and budgets.

  • Bridge the gap between technical capabilities and the functional/commercial requirements of the organization.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external suppliers to ensure the timely delivery of competitive and sustainable products.

  • Stay continuously up-to-date with the latest trends and developments in web applications and programming languages to broaden our technological base.

About Payter

At Payter, we are innovators, pioneers, and leaders in the dynamic realm of unattended/self-service contactless and cashless payment technology in a wide range of markets such as Electrical Vehicle Charging, Transportation, Retail, Hospitality, Vending, Charity, Parking, and beyond. The adaptable Payter platform accommodates a diverse range of payment technologies (NFC, EMV, ApplePay, GooglePay, etc.), international banking processes, closed-loop payment and loyalty schemes, and telemetry.

Through continuous innovation and in-house development, we redefine how vendors connect with their customers, empowering them to boost revenue, enhance user experiences, and access real-time sales and performance data. We support a broad range of technologies, from Contact & Contactless EMV, Mifare, WiFi, 5G, Bluetooth, Touch Screens and more. Our state-of-the-art products have an extremely long service life, are of high quality, compliant with multiple international standards, boast great design, are user-friendly for all, multifunctional, and easy to integrate.

Examples of successful collaborations include:

  • EV Charging: Fastned, Shell, BP, Ionity, Alfen, EVBOX

  • Cashless Charity Donations: Hartstichting, WWF, Save the Children, Royal British Legion

  • Food & Drink Vending: Coca Cola, Lavazza, Starbucks, Jacobs Douwe Egberts, Costa, Heineken, Maas International, Franke, WMF, Wurlitzer, Selecta

  • Hospitality & Public Locations: Compass Group, Sodexo, Albron, TU Delft, TU Eindhoven

  • Gaming & Entertainment: Pinball, Slot Machines, Gaming Arcades, Efteling


  • You have strong, proven experience with HTML and CSS (this is required).

  • You are highly proficient in Angular (2+) or TypeScript (this is required).

  • You are familiar with Agile working methodologies and thrive in an iterative development environment.

  • You possess strong problem-solving skills and an exceptionally keen eye for detail.

  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with your team and stakeholders.

What We Offer

  • A challenging role with varied work in a successful, fast-growing, and international organization.

  • 25 vacation days + 12 balance days per year for an optimal work-life balance.

  • Competitive primary and secondary benefits, including a travel allowance and an attractive pension plan.

  • A young and enthusiastic team of around 20 direct colleagues within an informal, no-nonsense working atmosphere.

  • Room for growth, with plenty of training and development opportunities.

  • A modern and highly accessible workplace in Rotterdam, in an environment where quality and service are always a top priority.

title: Mechanical Test Engineer
original_description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Test Engineer to support the Test Centre of the European Space Agency (ESA) as part of a Workforce Management Service proposal at their location in Noordwijk, The Netherlands. 

 

 The purpose of this Support Service is to provide technical support to the Engineering Services Section and the Test Facilities and Laboratories Section across multiple technical domains, ensuring the efficient operation, maintenance, and development of the Test Centre's facilities, infrastructure, and test capabilities. 

 

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage). 

 

ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, handicap, or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. 

 

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: 

  • Design, develop, and maintain Mechanical Ground Support Equipment (MGSE) to support testing activities within ESTEC laboratories and Test Centre facilities; 

  • Produce 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and technical documentation suitable for fabrication and implementation; 

  • Perform structural and engineering analyses, including finite element modelling (FEM), to verify design compliance and performance; 

  • Prepare design justification documentation, including calculations, assumptions, analyses, and technical recommendations; 

  • Ensure MGSE designs comply with applicable technical requirements, quality standards, and ESA regulations; 

  • Provide engineering support during manufacturing, assembly, installation, and commissioning activities; 

  • Coordinate and execute verification activities, including inspections, proof load tests, acceptance testing, and related assessments; 

  • Manage the development, modification, and upgrade of test facilities in response to operational and engineering requirements; 

  • Gather and consolidate technical requirements from stakeholders and translate them into engineering solutions and technical specifications; 

  • Support procurement activities through the preparation of technical specifications, technical evaluations, and supplier coordination; 

  • Plan, supervise, and coordinate facility development activities throughout the project lifecycle; 

  • Liaise with internal teams, laboratory personnel, contractors, and suppliers to ensure successful project delivery; 

  • Monitor technical, quality, safety, and schedule compliance for design and facility development activities; 

  • Develop and maintain engineering documentation, including 3D models, electrical schematics, P&ID diagrams, reports, and configuration records; 

  • Support testing, audits, and acceptance activities related to engineered systems, equipment, and test facilities. 


Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. 

  • Master's degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; 

  • At least 4 years of proven experience in mechanical design and development of engineering systems, equipment, or test facilities; 

  • Experience with 3D CAD design tools, ideally 3DX (3DEXPERIENCE) or equivalent software; 

  • Experience performing structural analyses and finite element modelling (FEM), preferably using Nastran/Patran or similar tools; 

  • Ability to produce manufacturing drawings, technical specifications, and design justification documentation; 

  • Experience managing technical projects, facility developments, or engineering modifications involving multiple stakeholders; 

  • Knowledge of testing, verification, inspection, and acceptance processes for engineering hardware and facilities; 

  • Experience developing technical documentation, including engineering reports, schematics, and P&ID diagrams; 

  • Strong analytical, organisational, and communication skills; 

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken; 

  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the EU. 

 

Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

The department is organized according to agile principles in a SAFe value stream. The value stream currently consists of three ARTs, each with experts of different backgrounds and levels of maturity. You will be a reliable point of contact for technical questions regarding the Ping Identity Platform in the value stream.

  • Experience with Ping/ForgeRock Identity Management Solutions (AM/DS/IDM)

  • Proficiency with cloud-native technologies (containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, Linux/Unix)

  • Experience with programming on the JVM (Java, Groovy or any other languages)

  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and responsibility

  • Reliable, Self-Motivated and solution-oriented mindset

  • Eager to learn and share experience with team members

    Nice-to-haves:

  • CI/CD automation experience (GitLab or similar)

  • Familiarity with modern monitoring, observability, and security frameworks

  • Understanding of working in an agile environment and delivering incremental value


Want to know more about us?

We are serving the Swiss market as Switzerland’s leading IT & Telecom company. Thus, we are actively driving digitalization and networking, and tapping new paths for our customers and our employees. Our values are spark passion, aim high and stand true.

Since 2019, we have been building up the coolest DevOps Center with a wonderful office at the World Trade Center in the heart of Rotterdam. We are currently recruiting IT passionate professionals who are keen on developing high-quality software, have an agile mindset and appreciate the collaboration with motivated colleagues from all over the world.

What's in it for you?

Work environment

  • Agile way of working, multi-cultural work environment promoting work-life balance

  • Autonomy, flexibility, opportunity and growth

  • Cool office space in the World Trade Center Rotterdam!

  • Are you coming to the office by bike or car? You can park right here at the office

  • Be a part of our events to build a stronger Swisscom community - for example, culture lunches, fun quizzes, game nights and a lot more!

Allowances

  • Full relocation support (Housing, settling in, etc.) for you and your family

  • 200 euros per month Telephone/internet allowance

  • 275 euros per month contribution to health insurance

  • 5 Paid training days and access to Swisscom learning platforms

  • Travel allowance reimbursement

  • Gym subscription, Tax advice, and language course

  • Salary range: 60,000 to 70,000 euros gross per year including holiday allowance

Leaves policy

  • Work from abroad possibility for one month per year

  • Care, bereavement, maternity and paternity leaves

Contract terms

title: Backend Developer Golang
original_description:
At Payter, we build the technology behind millions of secure, unattended payment transactions. As a Backend Developer, you will play a key role in designing and developing the services that power our payment platform. Working with Golang, you will build scalable APIs, improve existing applications, and develop new features that enable customers worldwide to deliver seamless payment experiences.

You enjoy solving technical challenges, writing clean and maintainable code, and working on software that has a real-world impact. Together with colleagues across Product, Hardware, and Engineering, you will contribute to innovative payment solutions while continuously improving the performance, reliability, and scalability of our platform.

Responsibilities include

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Golang.

  • Build and maintain robust APIs that integrate with our payment platform.

  • Develop scalable, secure, and high-performance applications.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Optimize existing applications for performance, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Contribute to the architecture and continuous improvement of our backend systems.

  • Troubleshoot, test, and resolve technical issues throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and best practices in backend development.

Who We Are

At Payter, we are innovators, pioneers, and leaders in the dynamic realm of contactless and cashless payment technology in a wide range of markets such as Electrical Vehicle Charging, donations, transportation, retail, hospitality, vending, charity, parking, and beyond.

The adaptable Payter platform accommodates a diverse range of payment technologies (NFC, Apple Pay, Google Pay, etc.), international banking processes, and telemetry.

Through continuous innovation and in-house development, we redefine how vendors connect with their customers, empowering them to boost revenue, enhance user experiences, and access real-time sales and performance. We support a broad range of technologies, from contactless, WiFi, 4G, Bluetooth, Mifare, touch screens, and more. Our state-of-the-art products are future-proof, high quality, compliant with international standards (EMV certified), feature outstanding design, are user-friendly, multifunctional, and easy to integrate.

Examples of successful collaborations include:

  • EV Charging: Fastned, Shell, BP, Ionity, Alfen, EVBox

  • Cashless Charity Donations: Hartstichting, WWF, Save the Children, Royal British Legion

  • Food & Drink Vending: Coca-Cola, Lavazza, Starbucks, Jacobs Douwe Egberts, Costa, Heineken, Maas International, Franke, WMF, Wurlitzer, Selecta

  • Hospitality & Public Locations: Compass Group, Sodexo, Albron, TU Delft, TU Eindhoven

  • Gaming & Entertainment: Pinball, Slot Machines, Gaming Arcades, Efteling

  • Petrol Station Services: Shell, BP, Exxon

  • Special Products: Photo Booths, Dog Wash Stations


  • Proven experience in a similar Backend Developer role.

  • Strong proficiency in Golang (required).

  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL or other relational databases.

  • Knowledge of Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is an advantage.

  • Experience with RESTful API development and backend architecture.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Dutch is a plus.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including a discretionary bonus based on business results.

  • Great benefits like 25 leave days plus extra “wellbeing days”, a travel allowance and an attractive pension plan.

  • We are great supporters of flexible working, but we need to align.

  • Thrive in a close-knit environment valuing flexibility, work-life balance, and mental well-being.

title: Medior Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer
original_description:
The mission
Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams.
We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That’s why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth, and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process. Will you join us in driving this change?

Please note: for this role, it’s important that you already live in the Netherlands and are able to work from our Utrecht office at least three days a week.

The opportunity
As our new Medior Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer, you’ll help build and improve our SaaS platform across all surfaces: mobile, web and backend. You’ll work on our React Native mobile app as we scale it into a fully independent experience for mobile-first markets. You’ll contribute just as actively to our web platform, from intuitive user interfaces in React to scalable APIs and backend services in Node.js.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
original_description:
We are growing rapidly and constantly expanding our global contactless payment ecosystem. To support this momentum, we are looking for a proactive Embedded Software Engineer to take ownership of designing, developing, and implementing software for our state-of-the-art payment terminals.

In this role, you will be the driving force behind turning business needs into reality, starting by translating requirements into clear, functional designs. You will work closely with our hardware engineers and the broader technical team to build the platforms that power millions of transactions worldwide. This is an exceptional opportunity for a creative engineer who enjoys solving complex hardware-software integration challenges and wants to continuously develop their skills in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement high-quality embedded software and drivers for our cutting-edge payment terminals across various platforms.

  • Translate customer and business requirements into robust functional designs.

  • Set up and maintain the development and build environments, ensuring a smooth and efficient engineering workflow.

  • Evaluate and implement new development tooling to continuously improve our software engineering processes.

  • Collaborate closely with hardware developers to build scalable platforms, skillfully troubleshooting and resolving any technical issues that arise during integration.

  • Review and assess code, ensuring high quality standards are met, including evaluating deliverables from external subcontractors.

  • Continuously challenge yourself to acquire new knowledge, explore new technologies, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

About Payter

At Payter, we are innovators, pioneers, and leaders in the dynamic realm of unattended/self-service contactless and cashless payment technology in a wide range of markets such as Electrical Vehicle Charging, Transportation, Retail, Hospitality, Vending, Charity, Parking, and beyond. The adaptable Payter platform accommodates a diverse range of payment technologies (NFC, EMV, ApplePay, GooglePay, etc.), international banking processes, closed-loop payment and loyalty schemes, and telemetry.

Through continuous innovation and in-house development, we redefine how vendors connect with their customers, empowering them to boost revenue, enhance user experiences, and access real-time sales and performance data. We support a broad range of technologies, from Contact & Contactless EMV, Mifare, WiFi, 5G, Bluetooth, Touch Screens and more. Our state-of-the-art products have an extremely long service life, are of high quality, compliant with multiple international standards, boast great design, are user-friendly for all, multifunctional, and easy to integrate.

Examples of successful collaborations include:

  • EV Charging: Fastned, Shell, BP, Ionity, Alfen, EVBOX

  • Cashless Charity Donations: Hartstichting, WWF, Save the Children, Royal British Legion

  • Food & Drink Vending: Coca Cola, Lavazza, Starbucks, Jacobs Douwe Egberts, Costa, Heineken, Maas International, Franke, WMF, Wurlitzer, Selecta

  • Hospitality & Public Locations: Compass Group, Sodexo, Albron, TU Delft, TU Eindhoven

  • Gaming & Entertainment: Pinball, Slot Machines, Gaming Arcades, Efteling


  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.

  • You have strong, proven knowledge of C and Android (this is required), while knowledge of Java is a strong plus.

  • You possess solid knowledge and hands-on experience developing embedded applications and drivers across various platforms.

  • You have extensive experience in platform development, working seamlessly alongside hardware engineers.

  • You are skilled in version control and release management practices.

  • You are highly independent, proactive, and consistently bring new, creative ideas to the table.

  • You are capable of conducting thorough code reviews, including those of third-party vendors or subcontractors.

  • You ideally have knowledge of GPRS, contactless applications, or mobile phone applications (this is a nice-to-have).

What We Offer

  • A challenging role with highly varied work in a successful, young, and fast-growing international organization.

  • 25 vacation days + 12 balance days per year for an optimal work-life balance.

  • Attractive pension scheme with just 3.6% employee contribution, we cover the rest.

  • Enjoy complimentary lunch at the office every day. 

  • A flexible hybrid working environment.

  • You possess strong, production-grade experience with Go (Golang) and Java for building distributed systems and microservices.

title: Engineering Manager
original_description:
The company 

Smart Electric Vehicle Charging Solutions. That’s the business we are in!

GreenFlux offers a cloud-based charge point management SaaS (Software as a Service) solution. This software platform enables Charge Point Operators (CPOs) and e-Mobility Service Providers (eMSPs) to successfully launch their respective businesses. With its offering, GreenFlux plays a pivotal role in facilitating the uptake of electric vehicles and the renewable energy revolution.

Our Development department is responsible for the technical design of new features, owns the architecture, and does technical operation. We are organised in agile end-to-end teams, working with well-defined and transparent processes. Our tech stack is centred around Microsoft .NET on Azure.

To keep up with the rapid market and business expansion and to support the company’s dynamic growth, we are looking to bring an Engineering Manager to the team.

The job 

The Engineering Managers (internally referred to as Heads of Engineering) are responsible for the performance of our development teams and the quality of our platform. You will be responsible for line managing the engineers of up to three development teams, ensuring they have the right direction, skills, and support to deliver high-quality results. Besides this, you will contribute to improving our agile way of working and strengthening engineering practices throughout the Development department.

Key result areas include:

  • Leadership and accountability: You are the hierarchical manager of the engineers in your teams and are accountable for growing those teams to become autonomous and highly performing. You set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and are accountable for individual and team performance. You actively identify and address performance issues and skill gaps, coaching and developing engineers to become more self-sufficient and effective.

  • Delivery and execution: You take responsibility for ensuring your teams deliver high-quality software in a predictable and efficient manner. You proactively manage risks, dependencies, and impediments, taking action when delivery or quality is at risk and driving improvements where needed.

  • Technical quality: You use your technical background to assess and challenge engineering decisions, ensuring that software solutions meet the required standards for quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. You work closely with engineers and technical leads to promote sound technical decisions and address technical debt

  • Continuous improvement: You drive improvements in engineering processes, ways of working, and the adoption of modern technologies, practices, and tools. You identify opportunities to increase efficiency, improve delivery performance, and strengthen engineering quality across teams.

  • Team development: You build and maintain high-performing teams by ensuring the right balance of skills, experience, and perspectives. You proactively identify development needs, support professional growth, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Quality and documentation: You promote strong engineering standards, effective quality control, and clear technical documentation to support the long-term stability and maintainability of our platform.

  • Strategic contribution: You contribute to setting the strategic direction of the Development department, translating broader objectives into concrete improvements and actions within your teams.


Requirements

We are looking for a strong and accountable engineering leader who combines a people-oriented approach with a clear focus on delivery, technical quality, and results. You empower your teams and create an environment where people take ownership of their work. You have a strong agile mindset without being dogmatic about tools and frameworks, and you know when to coach, challenge, or take decisive action to improve performance.

You have

  • 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager, preferably in a tech scale-up or SaaS environment.

  • A solid background in software engineering, with the technical expertise to evaluate engineering decisions and assess software quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Proven experience in leading engineering teams, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and addressing skill gaps through coaching, feedback, and development.

  • A strong focus on delivery and execution, with the ability to take ownership of results, proactively manage risks, and drive improvements.

  • Extensive knowledge of software development processes, modern engineering practices, and agile ways of working.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to challenge decisions, provide constructive feedback, and collaborate with different stakeholder groups.

  • The ability to think and act strategically while also translating plans into concrete actions and measurable improvements.

  • Fluency in English. Dutch is a plus.

  • A drive for continuous learning and self-improvement.

  • A sustainable mindset!

Our offer

Working at GreenFlux means working in a dynamic, innovative, and informal organization, where new ideas and developments move quickly, and each day brings new opportunities and challenges. At one of the most inspiring locations in Amsterdam, you will have the chance to actively contribute to a sustainable future!

We are striving towards an international and inclusive team, so we also offer Visa sponsorship and relocation compensation to expats.

Join our revolution in mobility and energy!

title: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform
original_description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

Hiring Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands (Hybrid Mode)

Total Compensation: 150,000 to 200,000 EUR

Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform

How you'll make impact

You'll help build the infrastructure that makes international payments reliable, scalable, and easier for businesses to accept across markets.

  • Design and implement new capabilities across Airwallex's international payments platform, helping businesses accept and process payments reliably across markets.

  • Build REST services and integration components within a backend microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend.

  • Shape the next generation of Payment Acceptance infrastructure, keeping merchant needs and business outcomes at the centre of your decisions.

  • Conduct architectural reviews, address technical debt, and improve the operational effectiveness of current and upcoming solutions.

  • Partner with the Payments Product team and, where needed, engineering teams at external partners.

You'll work in a hybrid setup, spending three days in the office.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Over four years of experience using contemporary engineering methodologies, with an emphasis on continuous integration and quality engineering.

  • Experience taking concepts from inception through implementation, with a focus on delivering thoroughly tested, high-quality solutions.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and recent hands-on experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring or Spring Boot.

  • Experience designing and building REST APIs and working with high-volume distributed systems.

  • Experience with Kafka event streams and distributed data storage systems such as Cassandra, Hazelcast, Oracle Coherence, or similar technologies.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, including services such as EC2, RDS, ELB, or CloudFront.

  • Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with operational tooling such as New Relic, StatsD, ELK, Datadog, or Prometheus.

Preferred

  • Extensive experience developing payment gateways, acquiring platforms, issuing platforms, or equivalent payment systems.

  • Experience integrating local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, or Trustly.

  • Experience working with major card schemes such as Visa or Mastercard.

You'll thrive here if

  • You've worked in a high-growth or scaling environment and know what it takes to build systems that need to grow with the business.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

Payments Platform at Airwallex builds the infrastructure that turns global payment complexity into reliable, scalable payment experiences, helping businesses accept and process money across markets with less friction. The challenge is balancing performance, reliability, local complexity, and commercial outcomes in the same system, where small improvements can materially affect conversion and failures are immediately visible. You'll do well here if you're thoughtful, pragmatic, and motivated by making complex problems feel simple to customers. If you want to build the platform that makes payments work seamlessly for businesses around the world, this is the team at the center of that mission.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Compensation: €125K – €160K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Stage Software Development
original_description:
Stage Software Development 

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou!


Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access,  geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld.


Bouw jij mee? 

Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en  ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. 


Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: 

  • Backend development; 

  • Frontend development; 

  • Embedded Software Development; 

  • DevOps; 

  • Security; 

  • Software testing. 


Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: 

  • Python; 

  • C++;

  • Rust; 

  • Angular; 

  • Typescript; 

  • Playwright; 

  • Zabbix; 

  • Linux; 

  • MariaDB;

  • Kubernetes; 

  • SALT. 

Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. 


Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten?

  • Studio for e-mail

Door de aanhoudende groei van het aantal IXON Cloud-gebruikers neemt de diversiteit aan specifieke wensen toe. Een veelgehoorde behoefte is het personaliseren van e-mailberichten die vanuit het platform naar de eindgebruikers worden verstuurd. Momenteel zijn de aanpassingsmogelijkheden beperkt tot enkel de kleuren en logo's. Het doel van deze opdracht is om klanten volledige controle te bieden over de vormgeving en inhoud van hun e-mails. Om dit te realiseren, wordt een intuïtieve e-mailstudio ontwikkeld waarmee de gebruiker eenvoudig en naar eigen inzicht berichten kan opstellen en beheren.

  • Support Beckhoff ADS via pull application (Embedded Software Development)

Implementeer ondersteuning voor het Beckhoff ADS-protocol in C++ om de compatibiliteit van de IXON data pipeline te vergroten. Je realiseert de volledige koppeling op de gateway en maakt data-logging eenvoudig configureerbaar in de fleet manager.

  • Het versnellen van End-to-End (E2E) testen (Software testing)

Optimaliseer de End-to-End testomgeving van de IXON Cloud om de feedbackcyclus en release-snelheid voor ontwikkelaars te verhogen. Je identificeert knelpunten en implementeert versnellingsoplossingen binnen de GitLab CI/CD-pipeline.

Hier herken jij jezelf in 

Je bent een HBO student in de richting van (Embedded) Software Development, Security of aanverwant en bent op zoek naar een (afstudeer)stage met impact. Je hebt een passie voor het ontwikkelen van toffe softwareoplossingen en krijgt graag de vrijheid om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Daarbij ga je niet voor shortcuts, maar werk je gestructureerd aan kwalitatieve oplossingen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamplayer, die daardoor moeiteloos meedraait in een van onze SCRUM teams. 


Dit hebben wij jou te bieden 

  • Een mooie stagevergoeding;

  • Een relaxte werkomgeving met jonge en ambitieuze developers, met wie je altijd kunt sparren over de nieuwste technologieën;

  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie. 


Klaar om impact te maken?

Connect met IXON en ontdek onze stagemogelijkheden! Solliciteren kan snel en gemakkelijk, door te klikken op de onderstaande knop.

title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
original_description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.

As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years.

  • Strong experience in agentic AI.

  • You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses.

  • You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough.

  • You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs.

  • You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful.

  • Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

  • Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

  • Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

title: Security Engineer (Full Remote - Netherlands)
original_description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you will take ownership of protecting our product, our users, and our collaborators as we scale a fast-growing AI companionship platform. You'll work hands-on across application security, risk & compliance, and security awareness (plus keeping an eye on AI-specific threats as our product line evolves). Given the nature of our product (AI-generated content, including NSFW) you'll play a key role in keeping both our systems and our users safe, with real ownership from day one.

This is a hands-on role reporting directly to the Security Lead, with regular check-ins on priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Application Security

  • Perform weekly code reviews to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of security vulnerabilities across the stack

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests, and follow through on findings

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

  • Maintain and evolve our risk register, mapping all company services and prioritizing what's exposed

  • Support audit follow-up and keep GRC documentation up to date

Security Awareness

  • Communicate new threats to the team, document findings, and broadcast security updates company-wide

  • Run phishing simulations and security training (via Riot)

Monitoring & Coverage

  • Own the monitoring of security channels and alerts, including weekend coverage, so nothing goes unanswered

IT & Access Management

  • Set up and secure new employee devices (MDM), manage access provisioning/deprovisioning

AI Security Monitoring

  • Keep an eye on emerging attack techniques targeting generative AI (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass)

  • Track security incidents and vulnerabilities disclosed by the third-party AI providers we rely on

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Solid experience in application security (code review, vulnerability management)

  • Experience coordinating or conducting penetration tests / security audits

  • Comfortable shipping code and working with Git/GitHub workflows

  • Scripting/automation skills

  • Bonus: familiarity with AI/LLM security concepts (prompt injection, jailbreaking, adversarial testing) — this is still an emerging field, so curiosity matters more than proven experience

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable working in an environment with products that are based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €65K – €115K • Multiple Ranges

  • Mid • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €65K – €85K
  • Senior • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €85K – €115K

title: Engineering Lead – Connectivity Domain
original_description:
Do you enjoy helping engineering teams grow while keeping a close eye on technical quality? Are you a servant leader who leads through influence rather than authority? Then you could be the Engineering Lead we're looking for.

As Engineering Lead, you'll lead and coach three back-office engineering teams in our connectivity domain. Each team has about three developers, plus outsourced developers. You'll make sure the teams deliver predictably and to a high technical standard, that people keep growing, and that the work stays aligned with product goals. You'll be part of a group of six Engineering Leads, working together on team effectiveness, technical improvements and tech alignment across teams.

Location: Sunweb Group office in Rotterdam (Hybrid)
Start Date: Asap

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead, coach and develop three engineering teams, and build high-performing teams with a growth and blameless mindset

  • Ensure predictable delivery while balancing speed with sustainable engineering practices

  • Drive technical improvements and engineering excellence, and promote software best practices

  • Simplify complex technical solutions and help teams make sound technical decisions

  • Guide teams through change and build a culture of continuous improvement

  • Align multiple stakeholders across business and technology, and drive tech alignment on cross-team initiatives

  • Work with external technology partners and suppliers when needed

Who you'll work with

You'll work closely with other Engineering Leads, Software Engineers, Architects and Product Owners. You'll also work with technicall stakeholders from Hotels, Transport, Ancillaries and Purchasing.

Who you are

You're a servant leader with strong people skills, technical curiosity and high quality standards, and you take a pragmatic approach. You work independently, take ownership and stay resilient when you meet resistance. You hold teams accountable, balance business and technical needs, and are always looking for the next step to improve.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Fluency in English

  • Dutch and/or Spanish is a big plus

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams, and you're comfortable managing several teams at once

  • Experience working with cross-functional product teams and with Product and Architecture stakeholders

  • Strong skills in people leadership, coaching, stakeholder management and Agile delivery

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, plus experience with change management

  • A lean approach to problem solving and decision making

  • Solid technical knowledge of:

    • Software engineering and modern cloud-native architectures

    • CI/CD, DevOps and software delivery practices

    • Software quality, observability, security and operational excellence

    • AI-assisted development tools that improve engineering productivity

    • Lean software craftsmanship and continuous improvement

Your toolbox

Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, observability and monitoring platforms, and collaboration and documentation tools.

Not ticking every box? At Sunweb Group, we believe curiosity, energy, and the right mindset matter more than meeting every single requirement. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear your story — let’s explore the journey together.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Yearly gross salary between 77K and 95K plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft Learn and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.  

Ready for departure? 

Do you want to become part of our team as Engineering Lead? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 7 November

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.  

As part of our recruitment process, we use AI-supported tools to assist recruiters in matching candidates to job requirements. Final hiring decisions are always made by human recruiters.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-YV1

title: Full Stack TypeScript Developer
original_description:
Do you thrive where innovation meets execution? Great! We are looking for an exceptionally talented individual to join our Connected Services team!

As a Full Stack Typescript Developer, you will work across the full cloud-edge system, from our SaaS platform to our embedded robot interface, including the secure connectivity that ties them together!

Who we are

We are a fast-growing, high-tech and innovative company with one mission: Powering clean transportation by handsfree charging! We create reliable effortless charging solutions by combining soft robotics, cutting-edge computer vision, and value-added services. Rocsys enables its customers to electrify their fleet sustainably. 

Our headquarters are in The Netherlands, and we have an office in Portland, OR, USA.

Join us, and together, we can power clean transportation!


You make the difference

Rocsys relies on your contribution to accelerating the adoption of electric mobility by building the software behind our autonomous charging technology. Our work enables reliable, scalable charging solutions that support cleaner transportation and a more sustainable energy ecosystem. 

You will be part of our small, dedicated cloud team, giving you real ownership and visibility over work vital to the success of our company. Together with your teammates, you shape the cloud platform and connectivity layer, while collaborating closely with a group of around ten developers across various domains and our operational teams. 

This is not just dashboard development: Your code runs both in the cloud and inside real-world robotic systems operating in the field supporting clean technology that makes a tangible difference. 

In this role you will

  • Develop and extend Rocsys’ internal and customer-facing SaaS portals. 

  • Build and maintain web interfaces embedded in our charging robots. 

  • Design and implement tools that integrate robot software with cloud services. 

  • Develop high-quality front-end and back-end solutions in TypeScript across the full stack. 

  • Translate functional requirements into clean, maintainable, and scalable implementations

  • Take ownership of features from concept to production — whether deployed in the cloud or on the robot.

  • Be able to travel to the office as needed.


Your contribution

You ensure performance, reliability, and security across both connected and embedded environments, contributing to robust systems that operate seamlessly in real-world conditions. You also actively contribute to architectural discussions within the team, helping to evolve our technical landscape as we scale and improve our platform.


What you will bring to Rocsys

  • MSc in Computer Science (or equivalent experience)

  • 6+ years of professional web development experience

  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS

  • Experience with React (or similar modern frameworks)

  • Backend experience with Node.js / TypeScript

  • Experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases

  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs

  • Experience building secure, production-grade applications

  • Familiarity with Linux, Git, and Docker

  • Pragmatic mindset: balancing quality, speed, and maintainability

Nice to have:

  • Experience with embedded or constrained environments

  • Working on systems combining hardware and cloud

  • Performance and reliability optimization

  • AI-assisted development tools

  • NestJS, AWS (or similar), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

  • OAuth and modern authentication flows

  • Scalable SaaS platforms

 Your personal skills: 

  • Comfortable switching between cloud systems and embedded contexts. 

  • Independent and proactive, while working closely with a multidisciplinary team.  

  • A team player, experienced in agile/scrum teams. 

  • Structured and clear in your communication (English, required). 

  • Curious about how software and hardware interact in real-world systems 

  • You enjoy prototyping and exploring solutions in areas that are still evolving 

  • A strong eye for UX and building efficient, intuitive interfaces. 

What we offer  

We believe great work happens when people have trust, autonomy, and balance.

  • Hybrid working model with flexible hours

  • 32–40 hour workweek

  • Salary range: €6,000–€7,500 per month (depending on experience)

  • Employee stock option plan

  • 25 vacation days, with the option to purchase 5 additional days

  • Bicycle plan to support sustainable commuting

  • Free daily vegetarian lunch

  • Wednesday afternoon drinks

  • Strong career growth opportunities as the company scales

  • Office in Rijswijk, easily accessible by public transport

*This role is based in the Netherlands. Applicants must currently reside in Europe and be legally authorized to work within the European Union.

Our company values

  • We own it! 

  • Relentlessly Inventive

  • People with Passion

  • Leave a Better Planet

We are keen to get to know you! Apply with your CV and a few words on why you would like to join Rocsys. We look forward to your application!

title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments
original_description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll define the technical direction for Airwallex’s Payments Platform, lead architecture decisions and build highly reliable, high-volume distributed systems that directly affect merchant experience and business outcomes.

You’ll design and build scalable backend services, REST APIs, event-driven systems and integration components within a microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend. You’ll drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks and local payment methods, while partnering with product, business, infrastructure and external engineering teams to turn merchant needs into technical solutions.

You’ll raise the engineering bar through architectural reviews, thoughtful approaches to technical debt, strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, reliability and mentorship.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including Staff-level technical leadership or equivalent ownership of complex backend systems.

  • Strong experience designing and operating high-volume distributed systems, preferably in payments, fintech, commerce or financial infrastructure.

  • Recent hands-on experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring or Spring Boot.

  • Expert experience building REST APIs, backend microservices, Kafka-based event streams and distributed data stores such as Cassandra, Hazelcast, Oracle Coherence or similar.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, plus Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Strong familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as New Relic, StatsD, ELK, Datadog, Prometheus or similar.

  • A proven ability to lead projects from concept to production, with a focus on quality, testing, reliability and maintainability.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across engineering, product and business stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience building payment gateways, acquiring platforms, issuing platforms or payment acceptance infrastructure.

  • Experience integrating major card networks such as Visa and Mastercard.

  • Experience with local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, Trustly or similar.

  • Familiarity with authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk or PCI/compliance workflows.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading cross-team technical initiatives.

You'll thrive here if

  • You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you’re thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

  • You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

Learn more about your team

Payments Platform at Airwallex builds the infrastructure that turns global payment complexity into reliable, scalable payment experiences, helping businesses accept and process money across markets with less friction. The challenge is balancing performance, reliability, local complexity, and commercial outcomes in the same system, where small improvements can materially affect conversion and failures are immediately visible. You'll do well here if you're thoughtful, pragmatic, and motivated by making complex problems feel simple to customers. If you want to build the platform that makes payments work seamlessly for businesses around the world, this is the team at the center of that mission.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: IT Servicedesk Engineer (Senior)
original_description:
Make technology work for everyone

At Sunweb Group, technology plays a key role in delivering unforgettable holiday experiences to more than 1.3 million customers every year. Behind the scenes, our colleagues rely on secure, reliable, and user-friendly IT solutions to do their best work. 
As an IT Servicedesk Engineer (Senior), you are the first point of contact for employees across our international organization. From resolving technical issues and supporting new joiners to improving processes and maintaining our digital workplace, you make sure colleagues can work efficiently and without disruption. 

You'll join our IT team in Rotterdam and collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, and development specialists to provide an excellent employee experience.

Location: Rotterdam
Start Date: ASAP
Availability: Full-time

Your impact

In this role, you'll support colleagues across our international organisation, different hub offices and business functions. You'll combine hands-on IT support with ownership and continuous improvement, acting as a trusted point of contact for both colleagues and stakeholders.

Depending on your experience, you'll also take the lead in specific areas of expertise, support less experienced colleagues and contribute to improving and automating our IT processes.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve first- and second-line IT incidents and service requests through Jira, phone, email and walk-ins.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, VPN, Microsoft 365 and workplace-related issues.

  • Support onboarding and offboarding, including account creation, permissions, access and device setup.

  • Make sure new colleagues have the right tools and systems available from day one.

  • Manage and maintain user accounts, devices and workplace applications.

  • Act as an escalation point for more complex incidents and service requests.

  • Work closely with Infrastructure, Security and Development teams to resolve technical issues.

  • Contribute to ITIL-based service management processes and maintain clear knowledge documentation.

  • Identify recurring issues and turn them into opportunities for process improvements and automation.

  • Take ownership of specific areas of expertise, such as Microsoft 365 or IT service management.

  • Share knowledge, coach colleagues and contribute to the development of the wider IT support team.

  • Proactively engage with stakeholders to understand their needs and continuously improve the employee IT experience.

What you'll bring 

  • At least 4 years of experience in IT support, service desk, workplace support or a similar role.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure and modern workplace environments.

  • Experience supporting Windows 11, macOS and mobile devices such as iPhones and iPads.

  • Experience with service management tools, preferably Jira Service Management.

  • A good understanding of ITIL principles and service desk best practices.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to prioritise effectively.

  • The confidence to work independently, take ownership and act as an escalation point for colleagues.

  • Experience supporting, coaching or mentoring less experienced team members.

  • The ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues.

  • A proactive, service-minded approach and a strong sense of ownership.

  • Fluency in English. Dutch is a plus, but not required.

  • Microsoft, Azure and/or Workplace Management certifications are a strong advantage.

  • You are based in the Netherlands and able to work regularly from our Rotterdam office.

About Sunweb Group

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Monthly gross salary between €3,700 and €4300 plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance).

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.  

Ready for departure?

Are you excited to help build and support the digital workplace behind Europe's leading travel company?

Click Apply and join us as our new IT Servicedesk Engineer. Do you have questions about the role? Feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition team via

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment where everyone can thrive.

title: Freelancer UX/UI Designer (Design Engineer)
original_description:
UX/UI Designer (Design Engineer)

Location: Amsterdam, NL (beautiful office right near Leidseplein)

Work Structure: Hybrid (4 days on-site, 1 day flexible remote)

Experience Level: 2–4 years

Type: Freelancer

About Creative Clicks

At Creative Clicks, we move fast, think big, and drive results. As a global leader in data-driven performance marketing, we combine high-impact user experiences with sharp creative to scale brands across continents.

Our culture is built on our Triple E philosophy: Energy, Entrepreneurship, and Expertise. We operate with a vibrant, agile startup mentality and no corporate red tape. If you have an idea, you test it. If you see a friction point in a user journey, you fix it. We are expanding our Amsterdam headquarters and looking for a designer who ships: a UX/UI Designer who takes their own work from Figma all the way to a live Next.js production site.

The Role

This is not a classic handoff role. You design the experience and you publish it. Your Figma file becomes a live page because you built it, in Next.js, often the same week.

Day to day you will design and ship high-converting landing pages, onboarding quiz funnels, and lifecycle emails; manage the websites they live on; and keep improving them with CRO experiments. AI-assisted building ("vibe coding" with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or v0) is core to how this role works, not a side experiment. You will touch several verticals and own things end to end: design, build, CMS, tracking, iteration.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and publish, yourself: Map user journeys, wireframe, design high-fidelity screens in Figma, then build and deploy them in Next.js. No waiting on a dev sprint.

  • Own the website stack: Manage our sites end to end. Set up and maintain a headless CMS so the team can edit content without touching code, and keep deployments, domains, and tracking healthy.

  • Run optimisations and CRO: Analyze user behavior and funnel data, form hypotheses, ship A/B tests, and iterate based on real performance metrics.

  • Work across verticals: Landing pages are the core, but you will also design and build onboarding quiz flows and email campaigns, so the same brain covers the whole funnel.

  • Frontrun with AI: Actively use AI design and coding tools to collapse the distance between idea and live page. Prototype in hours, ship in days.

Who You Are

  • The sweet-spot experienced: 2–4 years as a UX/UI, product, or web designer, with shipped web work to show for it (conversion-driven e-commerce or startup experience is a major plus).

  • Master of Figma: Clean component-based design systems, auto-layout, interactive prototypes.

  • You publish, not just hand off: Comfortable enough with Next.js, React, and Tailwind (with AI tools doing the heavy lifting) to take your own design live in production. You don’t need to be a senior engineer. You need to ship.

  • Infrastructure doesn’t scare you: Hosting and deployments (e.g. Vercel), domains and DNS, analytics and tracking scripts, and headless CMS setup (Sanity, Contentful, Payload, or similar) are things you can figure out and own.

  • Data-informed and AI-native: You design what works, not just what looks good. You read funnel data, session recordings, and test results, and you turn them into the next iteration.

  • Thrives in a dynamic culture: Rapid A/B testing, quick iterations, shifting priorities based on performace data. You enjoy that.

  • Portfolio driven: Live URLs beat static mocks. We want to see things you designed AND built.

To Apply

Send us your CV and a portfolio with live links: pages you designed and shipped yourself. Tell us briefly what you built, what you would improve, and which tools you used to get it live.
