title: QA Engineer
original_description:
QA Engineer (Web, App & Payments)

Hybrid
Amsterdam, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
Technology

Job description

About Us

Creative Clicks is a leading global marketing agency with offices worldwide and 200+ professionals. Since 2009, we've been empowering brands, publishers, and marketers to attract and engage customers at scale with cutting-edge technology and creativity. We live by our Triple E philosophy: Energetic, Entrepreneurial, Experts. And our motto: One team. One dream.

The Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to own quality across our web funnels, mobile app, and payment flows. In this role, you are the last line of defence before every release: you decide whether we ship, and you make sure fast iteration never comes at the cost of a broken checkout or a stuck subscription.

You'll work hand in hand with our backend, frontend, and Flutter developers, as well as the Funnel Ops team, to validate critical user journeys, reproduce the edge cases nobody else can, and steadily replace manual checks with automation. This is an AI-enabled role: you'll use AI tooling to generate test cases, speed up bug reproduction, and write automation scripts, so you spend more time on the hard problems and less on repetition.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own release QA: build test plans and regression suites, and make the go/no-go call for every release.

  • Validate our critical flows end to end: onboarding, paywalls, checkout, payments, and subscription state transitions.

  • Reproduce and document bugs clearly, coordinate fixes with engineering, and verify resolutions before they ship.

  • Grow our automation coverage: automate repetitive tests, maintain release checklists, and drive down escaped defects.

  • Classify bug severity and set the escalation path within QA's scope.

  • Document QA processes and playbooks in Confluence so quality practices scale with the team.

  • Use AI-enabled tooling to accelerate test coverage, bug reproduction, and scripting.

Job requirements

What We're Looking For

You are structured but pragmatic. You like breaking things on purpose, you don't sign off on something you haven't seen work, and you stay calm when a release is on the line.

Must-haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in QA or test engineering for web and/or mobile products.

  • Hands-on experience testing payment and subscription flows with modern providers (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, or similar): checkout, card and wallet payments, 3DS, trials, renewals, cancellations, refunds, and working with test modes and webhooks.

  • Experience building automated UI tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar, in JavaScript/TypeScript. Able to investigate unstable runs, fix flaky tests, and tell a broken test from a broken product.

  • Experience testing mobile applications (including Flutter) and web applications in browsers and in-app browsers, using real device clouds such as BrowserStack or LambdaTest.

  • Comfortable working with APIs and verifying behaviour through data: REST and GraphQL, querying services and admin tools, and checking analytics events.

  • Strong bug reporting skills: clear reproduction steps, severity assessment, and root-cause thinking.

  • Comfortable making and defending release readiness decisions with engineering and product stakeholders; experience in cross-functional teams with frequent releases.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Analytics and event verification: Mixpanel, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel.

  • Familiarity with products where a web funnel sells a subscription plus upsells, with content delivered via mobile and web apps. Experience with quiz-based funnels and performance marketing traffic.

  • CI and reporting: Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Allure, or similar.

  • Experience running load tests.

  • Experience using AI assistants for test generation, debugging, and QA workflows.

What Makes You Successful Here

At Creative Clicks, our top performers:

  • Take initiative and ownership.

  • Focus on solutions, not obstacles.

  • Stay grounded, even under pressure.

  • Collaborate closely with their teams.

  • Continuously deepen their expertise to inspire others.

What We Offer

  • A highly dynamic and fast-growing working environment.

  • An international company with more than 25 nationalities.

  • Competitive salary and fully paid commuting expenses.

  • 25 days of annual leave (plus the option to buy 10 more), with a healthy work-life balance and hybrid work setup.

  • A place to learn, discover, and develop yourself.

  • Warm daily lunch in the office.

  • A fun, ambitious, and young team of colleagues.

  • A recently renovated, beautiful office just 2 minutes from Leidseplein in Amsterdam.

Creative Clicks is proud to be a diverse and equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Selection decisions are solely based on job-related factors.

Apply Now

Ready to be the reason our releases ship with confidence? Apply now and join us at Creative Clicks.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Team Contract)
original_description:
Build the technology behind our holiday contracts

At Sunweb Group, we are developing a new internal application for creating and managing contracts with our suppliers and contractors.

As our Senior Software Engineer, you will help build this application from the ground up and replace an existing legacy solution with a modern, future-ready platform. You will have the opportunity to shape both the technical foundation and the way the new team works.

This is a new team with an initial size of approximately two to three engineers.

You will first be onboarded within Team Dalyan, working in a group of around five colleagues. Once the new Contracting Team is established, it will separate into its own team with a dedicated scope and responsibilities.

Location: Rotterdam Sunweb Group office (Hybrid)

Start date: December 2026

Availability: Fulltime

What you’ll do

  • Design and build a new application for creating and maintaining supplier contracts.

  • Develop cloud-native solutions using C#, .NET and Microsoft Azure.

  • Build user-friendly React applications for internal users.

  • Help replace a legacy application with a scalable and maintainable modern solution.

  • Contribute to system design, architecture and data-modelling decisions.

  • Develop reliable integrations and work with SQL-based data.

  • Apply automated testing, CI/CD and DevOps practices throughout the development lifecycle.

title: Frontend Engineer
original_description:
About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong.

What you'll do

  • Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas

  • Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's

  • Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape

  • Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual

  • Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

  • Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

  • Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

  • Ship in short cycles with your product team

  • Pair, review, and teach what you know

How we work

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons.




Must-haves

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over.

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out.

You've shipped production code with an AI agent. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar. Tell us where you let it run, where you took the keyboard back, and what you changed about your own workflow after a month of it.

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test.

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle.

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code.

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard.

Nice-to-haves

  • Claude Code in particular, or agent setups you've tuned for a team rather than yourself

  • TypeScript at depth

  • Storybook or component library ownership

  • React

  • TDD

  • PHP, or enough backend to reason about the API you're consuming

  • Familiarity with a complex, regulated domain (ours covers scheduling, time tracking, leave, and labour law across countries)

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You want your work in front of customers within days

✅ You'd rather own a feature end to end than take a finished spec

✅ You want a say in how a team writes frontend code with agents while the answer is still open

✅ You improve the code you touch without being asked, and you stop before it turns into a six-week rewrite

✅ You like a domain that takes months to learn

This probably isn't your dream job if…

⛔️ You want the technical approach decided before the ticket reaches you

⛔️ You want a job where AI stays out of your editor

⛔️ You'd merge agent output you can't explain in review

⛔️ You'd stop shipping to finish a refactor

⛔️ You prefer pixel work and would rather leave tests and architecture to someone else

⛔️ You'd rather work alone than pair and review

What we offer

  • A laptop on Mac, Windows, or Linux

  • 32 or 40 hours workweek

  • Hybrid, from home or the Zoetermeer office

  • 25 vacation days based on a 40-hour contract

  • Pension plan

  • NS business card or travel expenses reimbursed.

  • Training budget for personal development

Please be aware that this is not a remote position and we are not taking applications in consideration outside of the Netherlands for this position.

title: Senior Data Engineer
original_description:
Data Engineer

Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them.

Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet.

You will build the foundation that fixes this.

What you'll do

  • Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it.

  • Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production.

  • Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team.

  • Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent.

  • Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io.

  • Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today.

  • Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards.

What success looks like in your first 3–6 months

  • The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring.

  • You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work

  • Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do.

  • Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them.


What we're looking for

You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in:

  • Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse

  • Advanced SQL as your daily working language

  • Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP

  • Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience.

  • ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management

  • Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start

  • Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration

  • Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment

Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. English is our working language, and Dutch is not required.

This role isn't infrastructure engineering, ML or MLOps, or dashboard analysis. The Platform team owns infrastructure, the Product ML team owns ML, and the business teams own dashboards. It also isn't for someone who has only maintained a warehouse another person designed. You build the foundation properly, stay transparent about data quality and trade-offs, and treat the warehouse as a product for the whole company. You'll report to the Head of Operations and partner closely with the Platform team on the company's data architecture.

title: Full Stack Developer
original_description:
De uitdaging

Ons zusterbedrijf SphereIT bouwt moderne webapplicaties en platformen die slim, schaalbaar en betrouwbaar moeten zijn. Als Full Stack Developer werk je aan zowel de backend-logica als de frontend-ervaring, van architectuur tot implementatie.

Wat ga je doen?

Bij SphereIT versterk je een developmentteam dat verantwoordelijk is voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van verschillende applicaties. Jij schakelt moeiteloos tussen frontend en backend, kijkt kritisch naar codekwaliteit en helpt mee aan het neerzetten van moderne software-architectuur. Je bent betrokken bij elke fase: van requirements en technical design tot oplevering en nazorg.

Hoe je impact maakt

Je ontwikkelt schaalbare applicaties, zowel aan de front- als backend, en werkt aan architectuur, technische ontwerpen en integraties tussen verschillende modules. Je schrijft begrijpelijke, efficiënte en onderhoudbare code, test en reviewt software en optimaliseert deze voor zowel performance als veiligheid. Daarnaast zorg je voor duidelijke documentatie, zodat andere developers goed kunnen samenwerken. Je begeleidt de live-gang, draagt bij aan stabiliteit en nazorg, en denkt actief mee over nieuwe ideeën, verbeteringen en slimme oplossingen.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris: €3.300 – €5.500 bruto per maand

  • Mogelijkheid om jezelf technisch te blijven ontwikkelen

  • Een afwisselende full-stack rol bij een klant via GradeMatch

  • Een team waar je écht iets van leert

Wat het jou oplevert

  • Full-stack projecten waarin je écht een technische bijdrage levert.

  • Ruimte om je te verdiepen in moderne frameworks, microservices en cloud.

  • Ervaren developers om mee te sparren en van te leren.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting Senior Developer of Tech Lead.

  • Projecten waar kwaliteit belangrijker is dan haast.

Takenverdeling

50% Applicaties bouwen

20% Testen & reviewen

10% Documenteren

7% Live-gang & nazorg

5% Requirements opstellen

5% Architectuur & design


Hard skills

  • Afgeronde HBO/WO-opleiding in Bedrijfskundige Informatica, Informatica of vergelijkbaar

  • Minimaal 1 jaar ervaring als Full Stack Developer

  • Ervaring met één of meerdere van deze backend stacks: .NET, C#, Java

  • Ervaring met development tooling zoals: Visual Studio, Visual Studio Team Services, Git repositories

  • Ervaring met frontend frameworks & tools: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, jQuery

  • Kennis van moderne architecturen en concepten: NoSQL, microservices, Continuous Delivery, TDD, BDD

  • Je beheerst zowel Nederlands als Engels

Nice to have

  • Ervaring met Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Git

  • Bekend met Agile/Scrum, DevOps of Kanban

  • Kennis van OO-design, UML of architectuurmodellen

Soft skills

  • Proactief

  • Communicatief

  • Probleemoplossend

  • Teamspeler

  • Doorzetter

Wat ga je doen?

Als Backend Developer werk jij aan het hart van de applicaties. Je ontwikkelt, optimaliseert en onderhoudt backend-componenten die dagelijks door honderden tot duizenden gebruikers worden gebruikt. Je werkt bij een klant via GradeMatch, midden in een multidisciplinair team met frontend developers, testers, product owners en architecten.

Hoe je impact maakt

Je ontwikkelt schaalbare en betrouwbare backend-functionaliteit in .NET, C#, Java of vergelijkbare stacks, waarbij je datakwaliteit, security en performance altijd bewaakt — zonder shortcuts. Je bouwt API’s, koppelingen en services die systemen soepel met elkaar laten communiceren. Daarnaast review je code, test je mee en voorkom je bugs voordat ze echte problemen worden. Je denkt actief mee over architectuurkeuzes en draagt bij aan de technische roadmap. Tot slot zorg je ervoor dat software netjes live gaat én stabiel blijft.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris: €3.300 – €5.500 bruto per maand

title: Lead Analytics Engineer
original_description:
Do you love turning messy business questions into data people can trust? Can you connect the customer journey from the first marketing touch through sales conversion, revenue, retention, and product usage and explain the numbers equally clearly to an engineer, a CMO, and a CFO? AIHR is looking for a Lead Agentic Analytics Engineer to become the hands-on functional lead of our two-person Data & Analytics team. You will own the translation of cross-functional business questions into trusted metrics, governed semantic models, and decision-ready agentic analytics; set the analytical direction; and build the most critical models yourself. You are transforming raw data into governed products that drive decision-making for our business partners.

 

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the global market leader in online training for HR professionals. We support customers in more than 140 countries, including organizations such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to continuously upskill and empower one million HR professionals.

Today, we are an international team of more than 100 people representing over 30 nationalities. We are driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow, while staying friendly, enthusiastic, and committed to helping each other succeed.

Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows.


Role and Responsibilities

AIHR's Data & Analytics team is part of Business Operations. You will work alongside Vahid, our Senior Data Engineer, and report to Leo, our VP of Business Operations. Our ingestion and warehouse foundation is largely established: data from systems such as HubSpot and our own LMS moves through ETL pipelines into Snowflake. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools.

Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business.

This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. It is designed for someone who wants to lead through expertise while remaining close to the work.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own and execute a rolling one-year Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing urgent business needs with foundational work. Guide Vahid through clear priorities, design reviews, code review, and reusable modeling patterns.

  • Lead discovery across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to uncover the decision behind a request and translate it into agreed metric definitions, governed semantic layers, and data models that connect the full customer lifecycle.

  • Set the analytical architecture and dbt standards; design, build, test, and document the most critical governed models yourself using SQL and dbt.

  • Own the full-funnel measurement framework—from marketing reach, demand generation, attribution, and customer acquisition cost through lead and pipeline conversion, sales cycle, bookings, and revenue to onboarding, product adoption, expansion, renewal, churn, and customer lifetime value. Keep core recurring-revenue definitions finance-grade and reconciled while showing how upstream activity drives downstream customer outcomes.

  • Own the logic and quality behind executive dashboards and self-service analytics across Power BI, Metabase, and AI-enabled interfaces. Present the results to senior leaders, explain every assumption, and respond constructively to challenge.

  • Partner closely with Vahid on warehouse and pipeline requirements, resolve conflicting numbers at the source, and raise the technical quality of the team. Apply AI where it improves development speed or data access, while using sound judgment around privacy, governance, validation, and trust.

A Typical Week

This is a hands-on lead role. The exact balance will shift with business priorities, but you should expect roughly half your time to remain close to the data—building, reviewing, and investigating—and the rest to be split across discovery, functional leadership, and decision support.

  • Design or improve a dbt model that connects data across HubSpot, our LMS, billing, or other source systems; write the SQL, tests, documentation, and metric logic needed to put it into production.

  • Run discovery sessions with leaders in Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Finance to clarify the decision they need to make, challenge the requested metric, and agree on the definition.

  • Work side by side with Vahid on source-data requirements, architecture choices, and implementation; review code and unblock delivery without handing off all of the technical work.

  • Investigate a commercial or customer-lifecycle question, improve an executive or functional dashboard, and present the conclusion—including assumptions and limitations—to the relevant leadership team.

  • Reprioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, resolve competing requests, and invest in the semantic layer, governance, and reusable modeling foundations that reduce future ad hoc work.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first three months, you have established a clear operating model with Vahid, mapped ownership of the most important metrics, agreed the Data & Analytics roadmap, and resolved at least one material conflicting-number problem.

Within six months, AIHR has a governed customer-lifecycle domain in dbt and an executive view connecting acquisition and pipeline to revenue, retention, and product usage, and has launched the first MVP of our agentic analytics platform to drive self-serve adoption. The underlying definitions are documented, reconciled where relevant, and trusted across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance.

Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established.

Throughout, you remain hands-on in SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and analytics while setting direction, coaching through the work, and earning leadership's trust in both the numbers and the roadmap.

We offer

  • A high-impact role as the functional lead of a small Data & Analytics team, with end-to-end ownership of the semantic layer behind company-wide decisions.

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation.

  • Substantial autonomy to shape your day-to-day work, with regular growth conversations and support for your career goals.

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home arrangements after onboarding.

  • 26 paid holidays per year, plus one extra day for each of your first five years at AIHR.

  • The option to exchange any two public holidays for two days of your choice.

  • A work-from-anywhere policy that lets you work abroad for up to 20 days per calendar year.

  • A pension plan, four Trust Days for ad hoc recovery, and access to the OpenUp mental health platform.

  • A personal development budget, training opportunities, and the books you need to keep learning.

  • All public-transport expenses covered through an NS Business Card, plus a MacBook and the equipment you need.

  • A beautiful office opposite Rotterdam Central Station, a satellite office in Amsterdam, daily chef-prepared lunch, regular drinks, team activities, and free access to the office gym.

Get a taste of working at AIHR in our AIHR Benefits Guide.

Apply for the Job

Are you excited to become our Lead Analytics Engineer? We would love to hear from you. We are aiming for a start date in December 2026 or January 2027.

P.S. If this role excites you but you do not meet every point, we still encourage you to apply. We care about the evidence behind your experience and your potential to grow—not a perfect checklist.


Who you are

You are a hands-on technical leader: commercially sharp, calm under challenge, and confident enough to defend your numbers in any room. You also have the patience to build data foundations properly and raise the quality of the work around you.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience across analytics engineering, BI, data engineering, or business-facing analytics roles, including substantial recent hands-on analytics engineering and evidence of leading work beyond your own delivery.

  • You have a proven track record of building semantic layers or governed dimensional models end-to-end—from business discovery and metric definition to production models and adoption—not only dashboards.

  • You have expert SQL and data modeling skills, strong production experience with dbt, and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable warehouse, along with a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker, Omni, or Metabase.

  • You bring strong financial acumen, but your analytical experience extends across the full customer lifecycle. You can connect marketing acquisition and attribution, sales pipeline and conversion, revenue and unit economics, customer retention and expansion, and product adoption into one coherent model. You understand how bookings, billings, recognized revenue, cash, ARR, and NRR differ without treating financial reporting as the whole analytical problem.

  • You have worked in a B2B SaaS, subscription, fintech, or marketplace business and have modeled several stages of the funnel spanning marketing or growth, sales, customer success and retention, and product usage—rather than specializing in only one function.

  • You explain complex logic in plain language, push back constructively on senior stakeholders, and build trust without becoming defensive—even when you discover that your own number or assumption needs to change.

  • You take pride in driving the analytical roadmap and architectural vision, leading technical work through architecture and code review, and mentoring experienced colleagues without relying on formal authority. You want the majority of your role to remain hands-on.

  • You balance pragmatic execution with rigorous analysis, adapting precision levels to fit business needs and operational constraints.

  • You are used to leveraging a broad range of AI tools to boost your productivity and know how to configure them to produce output that lives up to our quality standards and best practices

Nice to Have

  • Earlier experience in RevOps, Growth, FP&A, product analytics, or commercial analytics, ideally combined with experience in a fast-growing scale-up.

  • Experience with HubSpot, marketing automation and attribution data, subscription or billing data, LMS or product-usage event data, Personio, or building semantic layers for AI-enabled and conversational analytics.

title: Embedded Software Designer
original_description:
De uitdaging

Wij zoeken per direct een Embedded Software Designer voor ons zusterbedrijf Veynex in de regio Limburg / Brabant. Haal jij voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van slimme technische oplossingen en complexe softwarevraagstukken? Dan past deze rol bij je.

Als Embedded Software Designer werk je binnen multidisciplinaire ontwikkelomgevingen aan innovatieve projecten met hoge kwaliteitsnormen. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van requirements en architectuur tot implementatie en testing. Je werkt samen met ervaren engineers en krijgt volop ruimte om jouw technische kennis verder uit te bouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Embedded Software Designer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van embedded softwareoplossingen. Je stelt technische architecturen op, ontwikkelt software in C en/of C++, en test de werking van systemen. Daarnaast integreer je verschillende softwaremodules en zorg je voor duidelijke documentatie.

Je werkt aan projecten binnen Embedded Linux, RTOS of OS-less omgevingen en schakelt regelmatig met collega’s uit andere disciplines.

Hoe je impact maakt

Je bent een belangrijke schakel binnen het ontwikkelteam en zorgt ervoor dat softwareoplossingen betrouwbaar, efficiënt en toekomstbestendig zijn. Door jouw inzet verlopen projecten soepel en worden technische uitdagingen succesvol opgelost. Je draagt bij aan innovatieve producten en de groei van het team.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris: €3.750 - €5.500 bruto p/m, afhankelijk van ervaring

  • Goede begeleiding en een duidelijk inwerktraject

  • Werken in een professioneel en technisch sterk team

  • Hybride werken met goede thuiswerkfaciliteiten

  • Pensioenregeling en goede verzekeringen

  • Mobiliteitsregeling: NS Businesscard, reiskostenvergoeding of auto van de zaak

  • Veel ruimte voor opleiding en persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Wat het jou oplevert

  • Veel afwisseling in uitdagende technische projecten

  • Werken met moderne technologieën en systemen

  • Snel groeien in kennis en verantwoordelijkheid

  • Samenwerken in een hecht team van specialisten

  • Een rol waarin je direct impact maakt

Takenverdeling

25% Implementatie

25% Architectuur & Design

20% Requirements Engineering

15% Integratie

15% Documentatie


Hard skills

  • Hbo- of Wo-werk- en denkniveau

  • Afgeronde opleiding richting Technische Informatica of vergelijkbaar

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in softwareontwikkeling

  • Ervaring met C++ en/of C

  • Kennis van Embedded Linux, RTOS of OS-less systemen

  • Ervaring met Agile, TDD, OOAD of vergelijkbare methodieken

  • Kennis van communicatiebussen zoals SPI, UART, I2C en CAN

  • Je bent woonachtig in de regio of bereid om binnen een straal van circa 60 minuten te reizen.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en Engels

Nice to have

  • Ervaring met het coachen van junior collega’s

  • Ervaring met Jira, Confluence, Git of QT

  • Teamspeler

  • Communicatief vaardig

  • Leergierig

  • Nauwkeurig

  • Gedreven

title: Software Test Engineer
original_description:
De uitdaging

Wij zoeken per direct een Software Test Engineer voor ons zusterbedrijf Veynex in de regio Limburg / Brabant. Haal jij voldoening uit het waarborgen van softwarekwaliteit en het continu verbeteren van testprocessen? Dan past deze rol bij je.

Als Software Test Engineer werk je samen met product owners, domeinexperts en ontwikkelteams aan het opstellen van heldere en effectieve testplannen. Je zorgt ervoor dat software op alle niveaus van de stack grondig wordt getest en zet actief in op testautomatisering. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige testproces en draagt bij aan het verbeteren van softwarekwaliteit binnen multidisciplinaire ontwikkelomgevingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Test Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, uitvoeren en verbeteren van testprocessen. Je stelt testplannen op, scherpt requirements aan waar nodig en zorgt ervoor dat tests efficiënt worden uitgevoerd.

Je gebruikt scripts en geautomatiseerde testtools om software te testen, valideert testresultaten en rapporteert bevindingen aan stakeholders. Daarnaast ontwikkel je verificatieplannen, kwaliteitsborgingsprocedures en teststrategieën. Door continu te zoeken naar verbeteringen in processen en automatisering help je het team om softwarekwaliteit sprint na sprint te verhogen.

Hoe je impact maakt

Je bent een cruciale schakel in het leveren van betrouwbare en hoogwaardige software. Door jouw nauwkeurigheid worden fouten vroegtijdig opgespoord en opgelost, waardoor producten robuuster, gebruiksvriendelijker en toekomstbestendiger worden. Je draagt direct bij aan de kwaliteit van softwareproducten én aan de verdere professionalisering van het ontwikkelproces.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris: €2.350 – €4.500 bruto p/m, afhankelijk van ervaring en fit met de functie

  • Flexibele werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur

  • Goede pensioenregeling

  • Verzekeringen bij arbeidsongeschiktheid

  • Hybride werken met goede thuiswerkfaciliteiten

  • Mobiliteitsregeling: NS Businesscard, reiskostenvergoeding of auto van de zaak

Wat het jou oplevert

  • Veel ruimte voor opleiding en persoonlijke ontwikkeling

  • Werken binnen een professionele en technisch uitdagende omgeving

  • Veel afwisseling in uitdagende softwareprojecten

  • Werken met moderne testtools en automatiseringsoplossingen

  • Snel groeien in kennis en verantwoordelijkheid

  • Samenwerken in multidisciplinaire Agile-teams

  • Direct impact maken op de kwaliteit van innovatieve softwareproducten

Taakverdeling

40% Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, onderhouden & valideren van testoplossingen

20% Uitvoeren van geautomatiseerde en handmatige testscripts

title: Operational Technology Architect
original_description:
De uitdaging

Onze klant produceert grootschalige staalconstructies voor de energietransitie en bouwt aan een Smart Factory-omgeving waarin productie, data en security naadloos samenkomen. Jij ontwerpt de OT-architectuur die deze productieomgeving net zo solide maakt als de constructies die er van de band rollen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als OT Architect ben je de verbindende schakel tussen productie, engineering, maintenance, IT en cybersecurity. Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de OT-architectuur voor meerdere productielocaties en zorgt dat industriële automatisering, OT-platformen en data-integraties aansluiten op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Je rapporteert aan het hoofd IT en werkt nauw samen met interne teams, leveranciers en externe integratiepartners.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de OT-architectuur voor alle productielocaties

  • Definiëren van OT-standaarden, referentiearchitecturen en technologie-roadmaps

  • Opstellen van doelarchitecturen voor Smart Factory, MES, SCADA en industriële automatisering

  • Bepalen van integraties tussen IT- en OT-systemen

  • Definiëren van OT-securityarchitecturen conform IEC 62443 en ondersteunen van ISO 27001-implementatie

  • Voeren van technische regie op leveranciers en integratiepartners

Hoe je impact maakt

Jij brengt structuur en overzicht in het OT-landschap van meerdere productielocaties. Je zorgt dat industriële automatisering, OT-platformen en data-integraties op elkaar aansluiten en dat de productie stabiel en controleerbaar blijft draaien.

Door jouw architectuurkeuzes wordt de OT-omgeving toekomstbestendig. Je vertaalt technologie-roadmaps naar concrete standaarden, bewaakt de security conform IEC 62443 en zorgt dat leveranciers en integratiepartners volgens heldere afspraken werken.

Daarnaast ben je een vaste gesprekspartner voor productie, engineering, maintenance, IT en cybersecurity. Je zorgt dat deze disciplines goed op elkaar aansluiten. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan continuïteit, veiligheid en een professionele, toekomstgerichte productieomgeving.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris: €6.000 – €8.500 bruto per maand (bij 40 uur)

  • 25 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen (bij 40 uur)

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer

  • Pensioenregeling waarbij de werkgever het grootste deel van de premie betaalt

  • Hechte, informele werksfeer bij een stabiele, groeiende industriële werkgever

Wat het jou oplevert

  • Een sleutelrol in de digitalisering van een grootschalige industriële productieomgeving

  • Directe impact op de energietransitie

  • Ruimte voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en doorgroei

  • Werken met cutting-edge OT/IT-technologie in een complexe, internationale omgeving

Takenverdeling

35% Architectuur & strategie
20% Industriële automatisering & integraties
15% Security & compliance
15% Leveranciers- en lifecyclemanagement
15% Innovatie & technologieverkenning


Hard skills

  • HBO/WO-opleiding in Technische Informatica, Industriële Automatisering, Elektrotechniek of vergelijkbaar

  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring binnen industriële automatisering of OT, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar in een architectuurrol

  • Kennis van PLC-platformen (o.a. Siemens), SCADA-systemen, ThingWorx/PTC, Kepware, OPC-UA, Profinet, Modbus en/of MQTT

  • Ervaring met industriële IoT-platformen, Azure, API-integraties, Historian-omgevingen en netwerkcomponenten (o.a. Cisco, Mikrotik, Siemens, Fortigate)

Nice to have

  • Ervaring met D365 F&O, MS Fabric en Power BI-integraties

  • Kennis van IEC 62443 en ISO 27001

Soft skills

  • Strategisch

  • Analytisch

  • Overtuigend

  • Besluitvaardig

  • Organisatiesensitief

title: Medior C++ Software Engineer
original_description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As a Medior C++ Engineer, you will take ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You will design, implement, and improve robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems, and real-time environments. You will collaborate closely with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers to ensure system reliability, maintainability, and performance.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro's software architecture, hardware-integrated systems, and development processes. You build an understanding of how our software interacts with different subsystems and start contributing to the design, implementation, and improvement of software components in modern C++ (C++17/20).

Working closely with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers, you become familiar with our state-machine-based logic, DDS communication protocols, and Linux and real-time environments. You contribute to debugging, automated testing, and code reviews while building the knowledge needed to take ownership of software components.

After your first month you will be able to contribute to the velocity of the team by working on new features in the scope of the motion team. You will be able to solve complex integration issues coming from production and the field.

This is what success looks like

After 12 months, you have taken ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You confidently design, implement, and maintain robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems and real-time environments.

You actively contribute to improving the existing software architecture, ensuring maintainability, scalability, and performance. You design and maintain structured state-machine-based logic, integrate evolving hardware components into the software stack, and contribute to system-level design discussions and technical decisions.

You work effectively with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers to debug complex issues across software and hardware boundaries. You have contributed to improving testability and automated verification strategies, actively participate in code reviews, and help raise software quality standards.

After your first year, you will own significant nontrivial features and parts of the code-base of the team. You will be a key knowledge holder of the implementation of the motion software unit as well as accuracy calibrations and verifications. You actively engage in building the roadmap for the coming years together with other engineers.


What You'll Bring:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 4–7 years of experience developing C++ software in a professional environment.

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining production-level software systems.

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20).

  • Experience structuring code for maintainability and scalability.

  • Experience with automated testing.

  • Experience working in Linux environments.

  • Strong debugging skills in complex systems.

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience designing and implementing state machines.

  • Experience with hardware–software integration.

  • Familiarity with DDS or similar pub/sub communication frameworks.

  • Experience working in real-time or near real-time systems.

  • Python scripting experience.

  • Exposure to robotics or industrial communication protocols (EtherCAT, CANopen).

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary including pension plan

  • 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position

  • Hybrid work model

  • Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away

  • Annual training budget of €2000,-

  • Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics

We offer an environment where you can make a lot of impact, as you are joining a growing scale-up in MedTech. Our team of driven and talented colleagues enjoys solving the challenges in developing, manufacturing, and completing our breakthrough medical device. While working in an open culture, we strive for excellence in all domains. We believe in taking courage and like to challenge each other. We learn and teach, regardless of age, nationality or gender.

title: Data-engineer macro-economie
original_description:
Als data-engineer ondersteun jij onze processen op technisch vlak. Daarnaast bouw je nieuwe tools die onze cijfers efficiënter en transparanter maken. Je werkt op het snijvlak van automatisering en economische statistieken. Interesse? Reageer dan snel!

Waar jij het verschil maakt

  • Je helpt bij het opzetten, verbeteren en operationeel houden van onze systemen in R. Deze worden gebruikt voor o.a. het maken van tabellen voor Statline, Eurostat en andere belangrijke gebruikers.

  • Je ontwikkelt nieuwe toekomstbestendige tools om onze processen efficiënter en eenvoudiger te maken. Hierbij houd je rekening met de behoeftes van de gebruiker. Samen met collega’s verzorg je het beheer en de verdere ontwikkeling van deze tools.

title: IAM Platform Engineer - Keycloak & Java
original_description:
Heb jij visie op identity platformen, werk je graag aan moderne authenticatieoplossingen en krijg je techniek én samenwerking in beweging?

Reageer dan nu op deze vacature.

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Binnen het IAM Platform team van CBS zoeken we een engineer die wil bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige identity dienstverlening op basis van open standaarden en moderne platformtechnologie.

In deze rol werk je aan de ontwikkeling, integratie en doorontwikkeling van ons IAM-platform.

Je richt je op identity-componenten zoals Keycloak, federatie, authenticatieflows en koppelingen met applicaties en platformen. Daarbij combineer je platformdenken met engineering: je bouwt niet alleen mee aan een stabiele voorziening, maar zorgt ook dat deze verder automatiseert, beter integreert en makkelijker schaalbaar wordt.

Je werkt aan een IAM-platform dat veilig, robuust en goed beheersbaar is.
Daarbij:

  • ontwikkel en beheer je IAM-functionaliteit op basis van Keycloak en aanverwante identity-componenten;

  • realiseer je koppelingen met applicaties, API’s en platformdiensten;

  • werk je aan authenticatie-, autorisatie- en federatievraagstukken met standaarden zoals OpenID Connect, OAuth2 en SAML;

  • ontwikkel en onderhoud je maatwerk, extensies of integraties in Java;

  • automatiseer je deployments, testen en wijzigingen via CI/CD en werk je met technologieën zoals Linux, Docker, Kubernetes en Helm;

  • stem je af met architecten, platformteams, securityspecialisten en PKI-collega’s om consistente oplossingen te realiseren voor onder meer TLS-certificaten, truststores, mTLS en certificaatgebaseerde authenticatie.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je wordt onderdeel van het IAM Platform team van CBS. Dit team is pas opgericht en nog niet lang in deze samenstelling bij elkaar. Juist dat maakt deze fase interessant: je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw team, aan de samenwerking binnen het team en aan de technische koers van het platform.

Binnen het team werken collega’s aan verschillende onderdelen van het IAM-landschap, zoals Keycloak, PKI en cloud-native security. Samen bouwen jullie aan identity-diensten die een belangrijke bouwsteen vormen voor een veilige en toekomstbestendige IT-omgeving. In deze opbouwfase zijn samenwerking, eigenaarschap, kennisdeling en continu verbeteren extra belangrijk.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een engineer die techniek begrijpt én verder kijkt dan alleen de tooling. Je voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar ontwikkeling, integratie, beheer en afstemming samenkomen.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • ervaring met Keycloak of vergelijkbare Identity Provider-technologie;

  • kennis van OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SAML en federatieve authenticatie;

  • ervaring met Java, bij voorkeur in een omgeving met integraties, services, extensies of maatwerkcomponenten;

  • ervaring met CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, Linux en platformengineering;

  • inzicht in hoe TLS-certificaten, truststores, mTLS en PKI integreren met Keycloak-omgevingen; ervaring met certificaatgebaseerde authenticatie is een pré;

  • een proactieve houding, het vermogen om technische keuzes helder uit te leggen en een sterke samenwerkingsstijl met gevoel voor kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en eigenaarschap.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk.
Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4132,- en maximaal € 6275,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

Kom werken aan de feiten

We sluiten de vacature bij voldoende kandidaten.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Vue.js)
original_description:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 other countries.

How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. 
Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. As our Frontend Engineer, you'll shape features that make complex processes effortless for over a million users.


This is what you'll do 

As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Dyflexis, you'll work on our workforce management software used by over a million people every day, covering time tracking, shift swapping, and everything in between. You'll join a squad with a Product Owner, a UX designer, and other engineers, building features with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue.js. We work in six-week cycles: build for six weeks, then take two weeks to gather feedback, fix what's off, and plan the next cycle.

  • Write clean, maintainable code that makes our users smile

  • Build and evolve features in our shared component library

  • Collaborate with product squads to implement new functionality

  • Share your expertise in code reviews and team sessions

  • Work with JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue.js 3, Pinia, and Vite day to day

  • Level up our mobile app development with Ionic and Capacitor

This is what you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience with JavaScript and Vue.js

  • Strong grasp of modern frontend development principles, including writing CSS from scratch

  • Experience with TypeScript and modern frontend tooling

  • Comfortable working autonomously, no hand-holding needed, and delivering within agreed timeframes

  • Strong communication skills in English, able to explain technical topics to non-technical colleagues

  • Bonus points for mobile app experience (Ionic, Capacitor, Cordova), feature-sliced design, Tanstack Query, or Vitest


What you'll get

At Dyflexis, you'll be part of an ambitious, energetic, and customer-focused team. We offer:

  • Fixed salary up to €6.500 gross per month based on a 40-hour week (skill based)

  • Personal development budget to level up your skills

  • 25 vacation days + your birthday off in exchange for cake

  • An in-house chef surprising you daily with fresh lunch

  • The best parties, drinks & trips (Winter sports, Ibiza & more)

  • Membership at ARJ Training boxing gym (home of champion Tarik & Levi Rigters)

  • Solid pension plan & 8% holiday allowance

  • Buy or sell vacation days, you decide

  • Travel allowance and WFH compensation

  • Friday chair massages to kick off your weekend

Apply now

Ready to help innovate the world of workforce management? Hit apply. No cover letter needed, we’ll ask a few questions and get back to you quickly.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated.

title: Data Engineer
original_description:
De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord.

Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA). Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds;

  • Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten;

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (PHP & Vue.js)
original_description:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 other countries.

How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers.  We're expanding the engineering team, and we need a Senior Full Stack developer who moves across the stack and unblocks whatever's stuck, frontend or backend.


This is what you'll do
You'll join a project squad, consisting out of a Product Owner, UX designer, and fellow engineers, and move across the stack as the work demands it. One day you're deep in a Vue.js3 component, the next you're in PHP8 and MySQL sorting out the backend logic that's blocking the Frontend team. Your job isn't to pick a lane; it's to keep features moving from idea to release for over a million users.

You'll start on tickets, get to know the codebase and how we work, then move onto full projects. We build in six-week cycles, followed by two weeks to reflect and reset. Join early, question assumptions, stay close to the team throughout.

  • Build features end-to-end across Vue.js3 and PHP8/ Symfony depending on what's blocking the squad

  • Design technical solutions with your fellow engineers, product owner, designer, and UX colleagues

  • Review merge requests. Give direct feedback. Take it well too. Keep performance and security front of mind: measure it, flag issues, and propose alternatives when something's off

  • Keep sight of the bigger picture: understand what you're building and why, so your work never drifts from where the product is headed


This is what you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience as a senior Full Stack Developer, equally comfortable working across frontend and backend code.  Bonus: B2B, SaaS, or HR-tech background.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Vue.js3, PHP 8 (Symfony), and MySQL

  • Comfortable with Git (GitLab or GitHub), Docker, and automated testing

  • A solid grip on security best practices, and the ability to measure and optimise performance

  • A problem-solving mindset, active listening, and the adaptability to switch between frontend and backend as a project need


What you'll get

At Dyflexis, you'll be part of an ambitious, energetic, and customer-focused team. We offer:

  • Fixed salary up to 6.500€ gross per month based on a 40-hour week (skill based)

  • Personal development budget to level up your skills

  • 25 vacation days + your birthday off in exchange for cake

  • An in-house chef surprising you daily with fresh lunch

  • The best parties, drinks & trips (Winter sports, Ibiza & more)

  • Membership at ARJ Training boxing gym (home of champion Tarik & Levi Rigters)

  • Solid pension plan & 8% holiday allowance

  • Buy or sell vacation days, you decide

  • Travel allowance and WFH compensation

  • Friday chair massages to kick off your weekend

Apply now
Ready to unblock a growing team and ship features a million people use?
Hit apply. No cover letter needed, we'll ask a few questions and get back to you quickly.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated.

title: Data Engineer Logistics
original_description:
Als Data Engineer word je onderdeel van het Data & Analytics-team in Rotterdam. Het grootste deel van je tijd werk je voor Business Unit Liquid Food, waar je functioneel en technisch mede-eigenaar bent van het datawarehouse en zorgt dat betrouwbare data beschikbaar is voor analyse en besluitvorming. Je combineert data engineering (back-end) met BI, en vertaalt businessvragen naar schaalbare oplossingen: van betrouwbare datastromen en semantische modellen tot dashboards, ad-hocanalyses en tender- en pricingtools.

Samen met je collega's moderniseer je het datalandschap, met volop ruimte om te experimenteren met predictive & generative AI, AI-agents, machine learning en procesautomatisering. Je standplaats is Rotterdam; om dicht bij de business te blijven werk je ongeveer eens per anderhalve week vanuit het kantoor van Liquid Food in Barneveld.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Het datadomein van Liquid Food beheer je: databasebeheer, architectuur, datamodellen, documentatie, datakwaliteit, continuïteit en doorontwikkeling;

  • Betrouwbare datapipelines ontwikkel en onderhoud je van bronsystemen naar het datawarehouse en de rapportageomgeving, voornamelijk met SQL;

  • Beschikbaarheid, volledigheid, juistheid en tijdigheid van data bewaak je, en structurele oorzaken van dataproblemen los je op;

  • Semantische modellen, dashboards en rapportages bouw je, en informatiebehoeften vertaal je naar heldere KPI's en self-service;

  • Aan businessgedreven projecten zoals tender-, pricing- en kostprijstools draag je bij, van concept tot beheer — zo sla je de brug tussen organisatie, processen en techniek;

  • Monitoring, logging, autorisaties en versiebeheer richt je in, met aansluiting op de centrale architectuur-, privacy-, security- en datagovernancekaders;

  • Kansen voor automatisering en voorspellende inzichten signaleer je, en continue verbetering stimuleer je via data- en procesanalyse.


Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je:

  • Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar, en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Ervaring hebt met SQL (3+ jaar), SSIS/SSDT, SSRS, SSAS en Power BI (semantische modellen en rapportage), plus dimensioneel modelleren en Data Vault-modellering;

  • Pré: Scrum, Microsoft Fabric, Python, Spark en Azure Data Factory;

  • Conceptueel denkt én praktisch handelt: je overziet architectuur en datastromen en vertaalt complexe vragen naar robuuste, werkende oplossingen;

  • Businessgericht, kritisch en verbindend bent, de taal van business én IT spreekt, en proactief eigenaarschap neemt;

  • Goed communiceert in Nederlands en Engels, in woord en geschrift.

  • Je bereidt bent om eens in de anderhalve week vanuit Barneveld te werken (must)!

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een passend salaris tussen € 3.651,- tot € 5.014,- bruto per maand, een laptop van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld, een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Ruimte om te ondernemen: een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen;

  • Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam, thuis en ongeveer eens per anderhalve week vanuit Barneveld (richtlijn bij fulltime: 3 dagen kantoor, 2 dagen thuis), inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding en flexibele werktijden;

  • Volop ruimte om te blijven ontwikkelen via de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen, e-learnings en webinars;

title: Senior Database Administrator
original_description:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 countries.

How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve. As our Senior Database Administrator, you’ll keep our complex database fast, stable, and ready to scale, while helping developers understand the impact of their queries on performance.


This is what you’ll do
You’re responsible for the performance, stability, and scalability of our database infrastructure, spread across multiple clusters. You’ll review and optimise queries, oversee migrations, and make sure our infrastructure keeps up as we grow, all while raising the bar on how we manage data internally. You’ll work closely with our Platform team, and with developers directly to make sure the database side is considered from the start.

  • Own production database performance: review and optimize queries, indexing, and execution plans using MySQL.

  • Run migrations across our database clusters, including working with Atlas.

  • Improve and evolve our database infrastructure, including scaling strategies like sharding and partitioning, as we restructure how our systems are set up.

  • Write and maintain the standards that keep database work consistent across teams, from data modelling to how migrations get done.

  • Handle regular database maintenance, from monitoring and mutations to schema changes.

  • Review merge requests and PHP code for how they touch the database and join project kick-offs to shape the database approach early.

This is what you’ll need

  • 5+ years of experience as a database administrator or database engineer, ideally across large or complex databases.

  • Experience in fintech, HR tech, SaaS, or ticketing and ordering platforms is a plus. A relevant certification helps too, though it’s not a requirement.

  • Deep expertise in MySQL, with solid experience in at least one other Database Management System. Postgres, Oracle, or MSSQL Server are all a plus.

  • Familiarity PHP skills, enough to read and review how developers write queries and loops.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. You can communicate clearly enough so that there’s no room for misinterpretation.


What you'll get

At Dyflexis, you'll be part of an ambitious, energetic, and customer-focused team. We offer:

  • Fixed salary up to €6,500 gross per month based on a 40-hour week (experience based).

title: Google Cloud Platform Engineer
original_description:
Are you excited by the idea of architecting and managing cloud infrastructure that powers complex web applications and data processing systems?
Can you design and implement scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions using Google Cloud Platform services?
And can you do all of this while maintaining operational excellence and reliability?
Then don't wait another minute to apply!

🧑‍💻 What we are doing?

Kaizo aims to actively guide employees towards achieving their goals and making an impact at their companies.

We are building a performance development platform for customer support teams that leverages gamification and AI to improve operational efficiency, elevate teams' performance and retention with actionable goals. We are a product-led, fast-growing SaaS company with a diverse team and a globally active customer base.

Kaizo is leveraging gamification and machine learning to make the daily work experience for customer support agents more engaging, fun and productive.

We run our entire infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform, managing Kubernetes clusters that handle 200+ million events daily, with data flowing through Kafka streams and being stored in Elasticsearch and MongoDB.

Our cloud architecture is designed around GCP best practices to create a resilient, auto-scaling infrastructure that supports our microservices ecosystem and data processing pipelines.

🗓️ What are your 12 labours here?

  • Designing and implementing cloud infrastructure solutions in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Managing and optimizing GCP services

  • Building Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and implementing CI/CD pipelines with Github actions

  • Working with development teams to architect scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions

  • Monitoring system performance, implementing observability solutions, and ensuring high availability across all services

  • Analyzing infrastructure needs, suggesting improvements to our cloud architecture with freedom to implement innovative solutions

  • Implementing and maintaining security best practices to ensure a secure and protected cloud environment, including IAM policies, network security, and compliance frameworks


🧑‍💻 What you bring to the table?

  • 3+ years of professional experience with Google Cloud Platform services and cloud infrastructure management

  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker containerization, and orchestration at scale

  • Experience managing and scaling Kafka clusters, Elasticsearch deployments, and MongoDB instances in production environments

  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Deployment Manager) and CI/CD pipelines

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (New relic, Logging, APM solutions)

  • Knowledge of networking, security best practices, and cost optimization in cloud environments

  • Experience working within cross-functional teams, collaborating with Product Managers, developers, and DevOps engineers

  • BS/Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

🏆 What's in it for you?

  • An office right in the heart of Amsterdam

  • Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desks, chair — there's something for everyone

  • Flexible schedule, remote work (within the EU time zone) whenever needed

  • Fun workations (2019: Tuscany, 2020: Zoom 😢, 2021: Portugal, 2022: Italy) & open holiday policy

title: Data Scientist
original_description:
Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow.

In a nutshell

  • Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed).

  • Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale.

  • Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics.

  • Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression.

  • Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events.

About Kaizo

At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing.

The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in.

What you'll focus on

  • Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably.

  • Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics.

  • Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume.

  • Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable.

  • Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions.

  • Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality).

  • Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product.

What you'll grow into

  • Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time.

  • Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation.


  • A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus).

  • Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data.

  • Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus.

  • An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume.

  • Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations.

  • 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply.

  • A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling

  • Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes

  • Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation

  • Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs

Who you'll work with

You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast.

What's in it for you?

  • An office in the heart of Amsterdam, with the flexibility of hybrid working

  • Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates

  • Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desk, chair, whatever you need

  • Flexible working schedule and an open holiday policy

  • Fun workations and team events

  • A clear growth path into Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer roles

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
original_description:
About us

Hey there! We’re Lleverage and we’re making AI automation actually achievable for businesses. We enable teams to capture, automate, and integrate AI-driven workflows and agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations.

We’re a team of entrepreneurs and innovators, who believe the future of work is 80% creativity, strategy, and human interaction, because AI takes care of the rest. If that sounds something you want to help build, we’d love to have you on board!

About the role

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you start by understanding the customer’s business: how people work, what they’re trying to achieve, and where they get stuck. You work alongside them to turn that understanding into AI workflows and agents that make a meaningful difference.

You stay involved from technical presales through implementation and daily use. Customer environments can be complex, from on-premise ERPs to undocumented processes. You enjoy thinking on your feet, testing ideas, and working through business and technical challenges together.

You’ll join our FDE team, working closely with sales, project managers, and product engineering. Success means building something people trust, use, and benefit from.

What you will do

  • Understand the customer: Work with end users and decision-makers to understand their processes, exceptions, and priorities. Help identify what’s worth solving and what a useful outcome looks like.

  • Technical presales: Help sales shape solutions, assess feasibility, and uncover dependencies. Build focused demos or experiments to explore possibilities with customers.

  • Build workflows and agents: Combine prompts, tools, data, and business logic on Lleverage to handle real customer tasks, with human review where needed.

  • Solve integration challenges: Connect solutions to customer systems, including on-premise ERPs. Work with customer IT teams to investigate interfaces, troubleshoot issues, and write custom code. Find practical alternatives when the first approach doesn’t work, and support fellow FDEs with integration challenges.

  • Improve what you ship: Evaluate solutions against real scenarios, improve reliability and quality, and bring customer insights back to our product and engineering teams.


What you bring

  • Customer empathy and curiosity: You listen carefully, question assumptions, and care about how people work. You build trust and translate between business needs and technical possibilities.

  • Applied AI experience: You’ve built LLM-powered workflows, agents, or applications and understand prompts, context, tool use, and evaluation. You can judge where AI adds value and where straightforward logic works better.

  • Practical engineering skills: You’re comfortable with APIs, authentication, data transformations, and coding in a language such as TypeScript or Python. You can investigate unfamiliar systems and troubleshoot complex integrations.

  • Resourcefulness and ownership: You break down unclear problems, test ideas, and adapt as you learn. You take responsibility for delivery, balancing creative solutions with reliability and knowing when to bring in help.

Nice to haves

  • Experience in technical presales or a customer-facing engineering role.

  • Experience integrating ERP systems, on-premise software, or other complex business systems.

  • Familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms.

  • A carry-on ice cream bar. It’s becoming our thing.

We offer

  • A salary of €65,000–€85,000 and a share package.

  • Hands-on work solving real business problems with AI.

  • An experienced, collaborative team working together in Amsterdam.

  • The opportunity to shape our platform and how our FDE team works.

.
