title: Traineeship Cybersecurity
original_description:
Have you ever thought about working in one of the fastest growing industries in the world?

You may have, but what if you don’t have qualifications? For ON2IT, it doesn’t matter.


We hire our people on intrinsic motivation for cybersecurity. We're looking for people who are genuinely driven to make the digital world safer. People who are curious about how a digital network works (and how they can be improved), who think like a hacker, and who won’t stop until they’ve figured things out.

We will help you become the top 10%.

How do we do this? Get ready for our Cybersecurity Traineeship.

What to expect: Our traineeship is a training program, where you will start working in our SOC. We have experts in our SOC who will support you in learning and obtaining various certificates. Cases enter our SOC via our own eventflow. Our SOC Specialists investigate these cases to protect the environment of our customers. You will learn how to recognize and detect threats and how to protect and guide our customers.

We will guide you with various trainings. This does not only include technical trainings. As customer contact is an important aspect of the role, we also offer trainings focused on improving your soft-skills.

The duration: 1 year

The working hours: Our SOC works in shifts to ensure 24/7 security for our customers.
This means you’ll work in rotating shifts:
- Two morning shifts (06:00 - 14:30)
- Two afternoon shifts (14:00 - 22:30)
- Two night shifts (22:00 - 06:30)
- Followed by 4 days off

What do we offer you? Besides an entry opportunity to become an expert SOC Engineer, we offer you a total starting package of € 3.750,00. Depending on the obtained certifications, this can be increased by € 400,00 within the first year.

What distinguishes our traineeship from a regular position? Our traineeship is designed for people who want to become the top 10% in Cybersecurity. This means that your development is our top priority. We have an unlimited development budget and you'll be surrounded by top experts in cybersecurity who are eager to share their knowledge.

Are there any prerequisites? You hold an European passport to pass the security screening and you have a driver’s license and the possession of a car (because public transport isn’t sufficient for the shift times).

Can I study for CCNA while applying? Yes. You don’t have to have your CCNA-certificate at the moment you apply. But you have to obtain it before you start in the traineeship.



What kind of person thrives in this traineeship? People who are:

  • Naturally curious

  • Calm under pressure

  • Communicating clearly

  • Motivated to continuously learn

  • Comfortable with dynamic environments and working in shifts

What’s after the traineeship?

You’ve finished the traineeship and wrapped up the first year. What’s next?

There’s a wide variety of paths you could choose. Think of certifications in:

  • Cloud Security

  • Networking

  • End point protection

  • Threat Intelligence

Most importantly: there’s no cap on your development. We would like to see you become the top 10%.

Practical criteria summary

In summary. To be able to join our SOC, you have to tick off the following boxes:

  • You hold a CCNA-certification

  • You hold a European passport to pass the security screening

  • You have a driver’s license and the possession of a car (because public transport isn’t sufficient for the shift times)

  • Your home address is located within a 50-minute drive from our office in Zaltbommel

  • You are open to work in 24/7 shifts

Want to become the top 10%?


Great! Take a moment to leave your contact details behind and we will contact you shortly.

title: Senior PHP/Go Developer
original_description:
In today’s world, cybersecurity is an integral part of everyday life. Companies need to be prepared for anything; at any moment a threatening situation can arise. Together with your colleagues (currently 8 developers and testers), you build small projects in containers. Those projects together form the software solution on which ON2IT’s entire business runs. We mainly use PHP and Go, but it doesn’t actually matter which language you use. As long as it works and is simple. Keep it simple, fail fast.

And we have hefty demands of our own work quality, so we have CI and CD fully set up. Code styling is automatically checked and corrected, security checks are performed and of course our unit tests and functional tests (Cypress and Codeception) run before we roll out. You put your changes into production yourself after a code review and functional test.


What you tell others you’re doing:

I build software that keeps our customers from getting hacked. Cybersecurity, yes, something with computers. No, that doesn’t mean I can fix your printer.


What will your work week look like:

As expected, you will mostly be writing code, which you will be doing from home and, at least 2 days a week, from our Zaltbommel office. We start the day with a (remote) stand up. There, we discuss the progress of the work. Do you need help? There are always colleagues ready to help you. The work consists of fixing bugs and implementing small feature requests or new projects. We record all these things in Gitlab. Sometime around noon, we have lunch together (unless you work from home of course) in our cozy canteen. Everything is completely taken care of; we just ask you to put away your plate in the dishwasher after. Every two weeks, we have a general team meeting and we do a retrospective as a team, that way we keep improving.


Is this you?

  • You have excellent knowledge of PHP, Go, Java, Python or a similar language;

  • You have a completed IT degree or you have demonstrable college level of thinking and working;

  • In your code, you don’t risk an XSS exploit. Never.


What do we offer you?

We offer ample opportunity to continue to develop yourself by aiding you in furthering your education and encouraging you to follow training courses. A varied and well catered lunch will be available at the office every afternoon.

You will also receive:

  • 24 vacation days, with the possibility to buy extra

  • Mobility allowance

  • Opportunities to work from home

  • Advancement opportunities

  • Unlimited learning: access to training and education

What does our job application procedure look like?

Have we managed to excite you about this job? Then we look forward to receiving your application! You can apply by clicking the button below.

This application process involves two rounds of interviews and an assessment. After this, we discuss the terms of employment in a separate interview. Positive completion of a screening is part of your onboarding.

If you have any questions about the procedure, contact our HR team: 088-2266200.

title: Architect Microsoft 365
original_description:
Als architect Microsoft 365 werk je aan de architectuur van onze digitale werkplek. Je zorgt voor heldere kaders, richtlijnen en keuzes voor Microsoft 365 binnen de organisatie. De focus ligt op enterprise architectuur en governance. Minder op het uitwerken van concrete oplossingen. Je werkt samen met collega-architecten, DevOps teams en externe ICT-partners.

Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen identity, security, samenwerking en compliance. Daarmee ondersteun je toezichthouders en collega’s in hun dagelijks werk met een betrouwbare en veilige omgeving.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwerpen en onderhouden van organisatie brede richtlijnen voor Microsoft 365 workloads zoals Exchange Online, SharePoint en Purview

  • Adviseren over identity en access en over security binnen het Microsoft ecosysteem

  • Beoordelen en challengen van technische ontwerpen van externe ICT-partners

  • Borgen van schaalbaarheid, veiligheid, compliance en prestaties van de architectuur

  • Documenteren van architecturen en zorgen voor goede kennisoverdracht

Afdeling
Je werkt binnen de afdeling Data, Innovatie en Technologie samen met andere architecten en specialisten. Samen zorgen jullie voor een stabiel en toekomstgericht IT-landschap.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding
⭐ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als architect binnen Microsoft 365, met aantoonbaar meesterschap in je vak en focus op expertise
⭐ Diepgaande kennis van Entra ID
⭐ Ervaring met enterprise omgevingen en het maken van doordachte architectuurkeuzes, altijd resultaatgericht
⭐ Goede communicatieve vaardigheden waarmee je complexe materie helder kunt overbrengen
⭐ Vermogen om het grotere geheel te overzien en architectuur te vertalen naar gezamenlijke doelen
⭐ Bereidheid om samen te werken als echte teamspeler, met het gezamenlijke doel voorop: pak het op en maak het waar
⭐ Proactieve en verantwoordelijke werkhouding, waarbij je eigenaarschap toont en continu zoekt naar verbetering

Wat we bieden:

📄 Je start met een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

💰 Inschaling in schaal G, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring ontvang je een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €65.000 en €105.000 (36 uur, incl. 13e maand en vakantiegeld)

⏰ 36-urige werkweek, werkdagen in overleg (bijv. 4x9)

🌴 199,5 vakantie-uren per jaar bij een 36-urige werkweek (bovenop je standaard roostervrije dag)

💻 Een laptop en een smartphone

📚 Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden

🚆 Volledige vergoeding van OV-reiskosten (2e klas)

title: Toezichthouder cybersecurity Crypto
original_description:
Als Toezichthouder Cybersecurity Crypto ondersteun je de AFM bij het toezicht op cryptodienstverleners die onder de Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCAR) vallen. Je beoordeelt de digitale weerbaarheid van organisaties en ziet toe op de naleving van de Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA). Daarbij combineer je kennis van wet- en regelgeving met inzicht in IT-risicobeheersing, cybersecurity en de technische werking van cryptodiensten. Je opereert in een dynamische en snel ontwikkelende markt waarin innovatie, toezicht en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Beoordelen van IT-aspecten binnen MiCAR-vergunningsaanvragen.

  • (Europese) onderzoeken naar de IT-risicobeheersing van cryptodienstverleners met een MiCAR-vergunning.

  • Analyseren van IT-risicomanagementprocessen, cybersecuritymaatregelen en operationele weerbaarheid en bepalen van benodigde vervolgacties.

  • Het analyseren van IT-incidenten, weerbaarheidstesten en uitbestedingsrisico's.

  • Contact onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders over risico's, bevindingen en toezichtmaatregelen.

Afdeling en Team

Je maakt onderdeel uit van het team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het toezicht op operationele IT en werkt zeer nauw samen met team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het toezicht op cryptodienstverlening. Binnen deze snel ontwikkelende toezichtdomeinen werk je samen met specialisten op het gebied van toezicht, crypto , cybersecurity en wet- en regelgeving om bij te dragen aan een weerbare en integere financiële sector.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ Een afgeronde bachelor- of masteropleiding op het gebied van (bestuurlijke) informatiekunde, (technische) bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta)opleiding;

⭐ Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen de financiële sector, technologiesector, (IT-)audit of een vergelijkbare omgeving;

⭐ Kennis van of affiniteit met cryptodienstverlening, MiCAR en DORA;

⭐ Ervaring met IT-risicomanagement en frameworks zoals ISO 27002, COBIT en/of NIST;

⭐ Certificeringen zoals CISSP, CISM, CISA of vergelijkbaar zijn een pré;

⭐ Analytisch sterk: je doorgrondt complexe dossiers en onderscheidt hoofd- van bijzaken;

⭐ Eigenaarschap: je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en werkt proactief;

⭐ Samenwerken: je zoekt actief de samenwerking op, deelt kennis en draagt bij aan een positief teamresultaat;

⭐ Communicatief: beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
original_description:
Help Build the Future of Secure Personal Data Sharing

At Ockto, our mission is to set the benchmark for simple, secure, and ethical personal data sharing. Already a vital part of digital journeys like mortgage applications, rental agreements, and private lease processes, we enable people to control and share their sensitive data with confidence.

As our platform grows, reliability, scalability and security become increasingly important. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you help build and operate the platform that keeps Ockto available, secure and performant across millions of transactions — and you keep it that way as we scale into new markets.

We are a team of curious, highly skilled engineers who value ownership, trust and continuous improvement. You’ll have the freedom to make a real impact while working in a collaborative environment with short decision-making lines.

The Opportunity: Senior Site Reliability Engineer

We are growing rapidly and pushing boundaries in secure, cloud-native digital services. We’re seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who thrives on impact and innovation. You’ll be part of a collaborative and diverse team, contributing directly to our SaaS platform built with TypeScript and .NET technologies in a public cloud environment.

At Ockto, you’ll find:

  • A dynamic, ambitious engineering culture that values trust, autonomy, and ownership.

  • A team of smart, friendly colleagues who share knowledge and challenge each other to grow.

  • A product with real societal value-empowering users to take control of their personal data securely and effortlessly.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work across engineering to continuously improve the reliability, resilience and security of the Ockto platform.

  • Design, build and automate secure, scalable AWS infrastructure and deployment pipelines using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.

  • Drive reliability and resilience through observability (monitoring, logging, alerting), incident response, root cause analysis, and disaster recovery / business continuity.

  • Strengthen our cloud security posture and operate the controls behind our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments — IAM, secrets management, hardening, and native tooling such as GuardDuty, Security Hub and CloudTrail.

  • Keep cloud cost efficient, balancing performance and resilience against spend.

  • Drive structured adoption of AI-assisted development workflows (code assistants, automated testing, spec-to-code pipelines).

  • Uphold privacy and ethical standards, recognising the responsibility that comes with managing people’s most personal data.

About the Ockto Platform

The Ockto platform enables consumers to securely collect and share personal data: such as identity, income, assets, and spending from trusted sources like government agencies and financial institutions.

Trusted by many organisations and financial service providers, Ockto replaces outdated manual data sharing with a streamlined, digital-first experience that benefits both consumers and businesses.

With Ockto, users are in control. No paperwork, no emails, just secure, verified data sharing at the click of a button.


About yourself

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering or DevOps.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK or CloudFormation).

  • Experience with Linux, networking and cloud-native architectures.

  • Experience with CI/CD, monitoring and observability.

  • Experience securing cloud platforms using IAM, secrets management and infrastructure hardening.

  • Experience with scripting or programming (Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell).

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

  • A passion for automation, reliability and continuous improvement.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with AWS security tooling (Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector or CloudTrail).

  • Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001 or other security frameworks.

  • Experience in fintech or another regulated environment.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted tooling responsibly in a regulated or data-sensitive environment (data-leakage awareness, prompt and secrets hygiene).

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge).

  • Experience with Docker.

  • Familiarity with operational-resilience requirements such as DORA.

What you get

We offer an inspirational international working environment where:

  • You’ll be working on in-depth engineering challenges with high-tech solutions.

  • You can grow and broaden your professional skills.

  • We respect a good work/life balance.

  • We have an eye for your unique person & talents and allow you to apply them.

Also, Ockto will provide:

  • A good salary;

  • Room and budget for investing in your personal and professional development;

  • A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice;

  • Phone- and travel-allowance;

  • Great home/remote working facilities;

  • Lunch fee;

  • Loads of activities like weekend trips, regular drinks and exciting team activities.

You will join a team that strongly values diversity and cooperation and you will experience a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.

Do you see yourself as the next Ocktonian? Then apply!

Want to know more about Ockto and our hiring process? Nice, below you can read more.

About our organisation

At Ockto, we work in a flat organisational structure with short lines and quick decisions. We work based on trust and responsibility within your own area of work. This gives you the flexibility to do your work under the best conditions for you. From the early days on, working at Ockto has been characterised by a very pleasant working atmosphere. With a lot of attention for good team spirit.

Our aim is to become the market standard platform for the secure, trusted and easily sharing of personal data in every country we operate in. Our Naarden based team already contains a variety of nationalities, and we hope to extend this even further when rolling out to other European countries in the coming years.

More about our company culture and core values.

Do you want to join us?

Do you see yourself as the next Ocktonian?

After your application, we will contact you within five working days to discuss the vacancy, tell you more about our recruitment process and to answer any questions you may have.

Would you first like to know more about the position and working at Ockto? Feel free to contact us! You can reach us via https://ockto.recruitee.com for more information, or other job openings at Ockto.

Your data is safe

At Ockto we only use your motivational letter and CV during the application procedure to assess your application. If you are rejected,

in the context of the GDPR, we will keep your application data for 4 weeks after termination of the application procedure without consent.

title: Senior AI Engineer
original_description:
Maybe you call yourself an AI Engineer, an LLM wrangler, a "does it actually work outside the demo" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Alex. Whatever you call yourself: you'll build and ship the AI that All Your BI puts in front of real clients, and own it end to end. Not demos. Production systems that survive contact with real clients — and when something breaks, you're the one who fixes it.

What you get

  • A salary between €81,000-€91,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Hybrid in the Netherlands: flexibility to work from home with office visits and occasional client meetings.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities.

What the job looks like

  • Build and ship the AI behind our products and client solutions: LLM applications, RAG over messy real-world data, agents and tool-calling. You take these from demo-grade to production-grade.

  • Own production end to end: when something breaks, you're the one who fixes it. You implement evals, observability and tracing, and guardrails against hallucination and prompt injection, so problems surface fast and get resolved faster.

  • Keep AI affordable: track cost and latency per task, and use caching, routing, and the right model for the job rather than the biggest one.

  • Work within the architectural guidelines set by our Lead AI Engineer, and flag early when something in that direction isn't holding up in practice.

  • Translate AI capability into real client value and push back on anything that's AI for AI's sake.


What you bring

  • Attitude and execution: energy, curiosity, and a strong bias to fix things yourself. When something breaks in production, you dig in and resolve it, you don't wait for direction. You can be trusted to own a production system without close supervision.

  • AI/ML engineering, in production: you've built and shipped LLM/GenAI systems that real people use, RAG, agents, tool-calling, not notebooks and demos. Strong Python, and you know the modern AI stack (LLM APIs across providers like Anthropic / OpenAI / open models, vector databases, an orchestration framework) well enough to know where it breaks.

  • Reliability & LLMOps: you make AI dependable, evals, observability and tracing, guardrails, prompt and version control, cost and latency budgets.

  • Client & business sense: you can tell AI that creates client value from AI that's just hype and explain which is which to a non-technical client, in strong English.

  • Nice to have: data or BI background or consultancy experience; cloud + deployment muscle (AWS / Azure / GCP, Docker, CI/CD); model distillation, structured outputs, and multimodal pipelines.

 

We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

title: Data Engineer Kapitaalmarkten
original_description:
Als allround Data Engineer binnen de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK) ontwerp, bouw en beheer je betrouwbare datapipelines en datasets voor het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten. Daarnaast help je onze ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen en het gebruik van Databricks verder te professionaliseren. Je ontsluit, structureert en prepareert gegevens voor data-analisten, toezichthouders en andere gebruikers. Binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving werk je met grote hoeveelheden gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data, variërend van miljoenen tot miljarden records. De gegevens bevinden zich onder meer in Databricks, SQL-databases en Azure Storage. Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare ETL-processen en zorgt dat data vindbaar, controleerbaar en geschikt is voor analyse en toezicht. Je verbetert de ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen met versiebeheer, geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD in Azure DevOps. Met Declarative Automation Bundles leg je Databricks-code, configuraties en resources vast en deploy je deze gecontroleerd naar verschillende omgevingen. Hierbij werk je aan herhaalbare en beter beheersbare wijzigingen en deployments. Bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen pas je de geldende kaders voor security, privacy en governance toe. Je draagt bij aan monitoring en kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform, in samenwerking met de verantwoordelijke platform-, architectuur- en securityspecialisten. Daarnaast ontwikkel je duurzame dataproducten en draag je actief bij aan kennisdeling, innovatie en standaardisatie binnen het team.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving en op het Databricks-platform met onder andere Databricks Jobs, Azure Data Factory en PySpark/SQL. 

  • Inrichten en verbeteren van geautomatiseerde ontwikkel-, test- en deploymentprocessen met CI/CD in Azure DevOps. 

  • Vastleggen en gecontroleerd deployen van Databricks-code, configuraties en resources met Declarative Automation Bundles.

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van datapipelines en deploymentprocessen voor machinelearningtoepassingen en bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van MLOps binnen het Databricks-platform.

  • Toepassen van kaders en standaarden voor datakwaliteit, security, privacy en governance, waaronder het gebruik van Unity Catalog. 

  • Monitoren en verbeteren van de werking en betrouwbaarheid van datapipelines en bijdragen aan kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform. 

  • Actief bijdragen aan architectuurvraagstukken rondom schaalbaarheid, security, data governance en cloudinrichting. 

  • Samenwerken met data-analisten, datamanagementspecialisten en platform engineers om technische en functionele vraagstukken te vertalen naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen. 

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en actief bijdragen aan innovatie, standaardisatie en kennisdeling binnen het team.

Afdeling en team

Je maakt deel uit van de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK), waar we data inzetten om het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten te versterken. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team met onder andere data-analisten, datamanagementspecialisten en een integrator. Samen ontwikkelen we betrouwbare datasets, analyses en informatieproducten voor toezichtsvraagstukken. Je werkt daarnaast nauw samen met experts op het gebied van toezicht, financiële markten en technologie. Binnen de afdeling is er ruimte om je vakinhoudelijk te ontwikkelen, kennis te delen en nieuwe werkwijzen toe te passen. Zo draag je samen met het team bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van datagedreven toezicht.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ WO-werk- en -denkniveau en minimaal drie jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie binnen een Azure-cloudomgeving.

⭐ Data Engineering: Ruime ervaring met Databricks, PySpark en SQL en met het ontwikkelen en beheren van schaalbare processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking.

⭐ Azure: Ervaring met Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage en andere relevante Azure-diensten voor gegevensverwerking.

⭐ DevOps en automatisering: Ervaring met Git, Azure DevOps en CI/CD en inzicht in het gecontroleerd, herhaalbaar en geautomatiseerd testen en deployen van dataoplossingen.

⭐ Databricks-ontwikkeling: Ervaring met of kennis van Declarative Automation Bundles en Unity Catalog.

⭐ MLOps: Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van datapipelines, herbruikbare componenten of deploymentprocessen voor machinelearningtoepassingen, of de motivatie om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen.

⭐ Security en governance: Je kunt kaders voor identity and access management, databeveiliging, privacy en governance toepassen bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen.

⭐ Monitoring: Ervaring met het monitoren van datapipelines, analyseren van verstoringen en verbeteren van prestaties en betrouwbaarheid.

⭐ Datamodellering: Kennis van relationele en dimensionele datamodellering, waaronder normalisatie en de principes van Inmon en Kimball.

⭐ Werkwijze: Je werkt iteratief, neemt eigenaarschap en zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega’s en andere disciplines.

⭐ Persoonlijke eigenschappen: Je bent analytisch, initiatiefrijk en gericht op het ontwikkelen van duurzame oplossingen.

Pre:

  • Relevante certificeringen op het gebied van Databricks, Azure Data Engineering of DevOps.

  • Ervaring met ML Engineering of AI Engineering binnen een enterprise-omgeving.

Wat we bieden:

💻 Een laptop en een smartphone

📚 Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden

🚆 Volledige vergoeding van OV-reiskosten (2e klas)

🏡 Thuiswerkvergoeding voor thuiswerkdagen

💪 Bijdrage aan een sportschoolabonnement

Hierbij werk je aan herhaalbare en beter beheersbare wijzigingen en deployments. Bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen pas je de geldende kaders voor security, privacy en governance toe. Je draagt bij aan monitoring en kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform, in samenwerking met de verantwoordelijke platform-, architectuur- en securityspecialisten. Daarnaast ontwikkel je duurzame dataproducten en draag je actief bij aan kennisdeling, innovatie en standaardisatie binnen het team. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden: Ontwikkelen en beheren van processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving en op het Databricks-platform met onder andere Databricks Jobs, Azure Data Factory en PySpark/SQL. Inrichten en verbeteren van geautomatiseerde ontwikkel-, test- en deploymentprocessen met CI/CD in Azure DevOps. Vastleggen en gecontroleerd deployen van Databricks-code, configuraties en resources met Declarative Automation Bundles. Ontwikkelen en beheren van datapipelines en deploymentprocessen voor machinelearningtoepassingen en bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van MLOps binnen het Databricks-platform. Toepassen van kaders en standaarden voor datakwaliteit, security, privacy en governance, waaronder het gebruik van Unity Catalog. Monitoren en verbeteren van de werking en betrouwbaarheid van datapipelines en bijdragen aan kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform. Actief bijdragen aan architectuurvraagstukken rondom schaalbaarheid, security, data governance en cloudinrichting. Samenwerken met data-analisten, datamanagementspecialisten en platform engineers om technische en functionele vraagstukken te vertalen naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Signaleren van verbeterkansen en actief bijdragen aan innovatie, standaardisatie en kennisdeling binnen het team. Afdeling en team Je maakt deel uit van de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK), waar we data inzetten om het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten te versterken. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team met onder andere data-analisten, datamanagementspecialisten en een integrator. Samen ontwikkelen we betrouwbare datasets, analyses en informatieproducten voor toezichtsvraagstukken. Je werkt daarnaast nauw samen met experts op het gebied van toezicht, financiële markten en technologie. Binnen de afdeling is er ruimte om je vakinhoudelijk te ontwikkelen, kennis te delen en nieuwe werkwijzen toe te passen. Zo draag je samen met het team bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van datagedreven toezicht. Dit vragen we: ⭐ WO-werk- en -denkniveau en minimaal drie jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie binnen een Azure-cloudomgeving. ⭐ Data Engineering: Ruime ervaring met Databricks, PySpark en SQL en met het ontwikkelen en beheren van schaalbare processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking. ⭐ Azure: Ervaring met Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage en andere relevante Azure-diensten voor gegevensverwerking. ⭐ DevOps en automatisering: Ervaring met Git, Azure DevOps en CI/CD en inzicht in het gecontroleerd, herhaalbaar en geautomatiseerd testen en deployen van dataoplossingen. ⭐ Databricks-ontwikkeling: Ervaring met of kennis van Declarative Automation Bundles en Unity Catalog. ⭐ MLOps: Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van datapipelines, herbruikbare componenten of deploymentprocessen voor machinelearningtoepassingen, of de motivatie om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen. ⭐ Security en governance: Je kunt kaders voor identity and access management, databeveiliging, privacy en governance toepassen bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen. ⭐ Monitoring: Ervaring met het monitoren van datapipelines, analyseren van verstoringen en verbeteren van prestaties en betrouwbaarheid. ⭐ Datamodellering: Kennis van relationele en dimensionele datamodellering, waaronder normalisatie en de principes van Inmon en Kimball. ⭐ Werkwijze: Je werkt iteratief, neemt eigenaarschap en zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega’s en andere disciplines. ⭐ Persoonlijke eigenschappen: Je bent analytisch, initiatiefrijk en gericht op het ontwikkelen van duurzame oplossingen. Pre: Relevante certificeringen op het gebied van Databricks, Azure Data Engineering of DevOps. Ervaring met ML Engineering of AI Engineering binnen een enterprise-omgeving. title: Haskell Software Engineer - Creatives Team
original_description:
What’s in it for you (to start with):

  • Gross monthly salary ranging from € 4.000 to € 5.700 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with your May salary

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description!


Your challenges:

The Creatives team works on and is responsible for our Image Editor and related image-processing features.
You will be working on the backend and sometimes a little bit on the frontend of a complex distributed web application. Our tool provides several different services, written in Haskell, Python, and Rust.

In this position, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of new and old image-related features in our application. An important aspect of our work is scaling our services to the next level, so we can handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput while keeping our app fast and responsive. To give you a sense of scale: a couple hundred millions of images are inspected, transformed and created by our services every day.

  • Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team

  • Design, develop, and test new product features

  • Collaborate with and review PRs of other team members

  • Improve the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Work on scalability and performance improvements

  • Collaborate with our other product and platform teams to integrate image-manipulating features with other parts of our tool.

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.

Who are you?

  • You have good programming skills in Haskell (or a similar typed functional language)

  • You are familiar with other programming languages and polyglot programming: we regularly need to make modifications in services written in other languages (especially Python and Rust) as well

  • You have approximately 4-5 years of professional software engineering experience 

  • You have experience in tuning and scaling a big application

  • You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, preferably Postgres

  • Good working knowledge of Linux, git, and the command line.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Haskell libraries like warp, conduit, async, servant, aeson, effectful

  • Knowledge of Rust and its ecosystem

  • Prior experience in image processing

  • Some knowledge of TypeScript/React, which we use in our WYSIWYG Image Editor

  • A passion to provide value to customers and figuring out the 'question behind the question'.

Practical requirements:

  • EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands

  • Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office.

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.


The team:

You will join the Creatives team, consisting of five more Backend engineers, two Frontend engineers, a Product Manager, and a UI/UX designer. 

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

More benefits: 

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets.

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: senior employees can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner)  will get in touch with you for an introductory call (25 minutes)

  2. Then you are going to have a tech interview with the team members (1h)

  3. For senior candidates, we schedule a system design as well (1h)

  4. After that, we will schedule a culture and role fit interview with the Creative Team Lead and one more colleague (1h)

When we don’t have enough information, we might ask you to work on a short assignment before your tech interview.
Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.


Important note: We know that in the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the first screening,  so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact from job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 to Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in diverse and inclusive teams

title: Projectleider Cybersecurity Congres | RDI
original_description:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI) op zoek naar een ervaren Projectleider. De RDI zet zich in voor een veilig verbonden Nederland en werkt aan actuele thema’s zoals cyberveiligheid, digitale weerbaarheid, AI, 5G en digitale infrastructuur.

De opdracht vindt plaats binnen de directie Digitale Weerbaarheid en richt zich op de organisatie van de NISDUC 2027 (NIS Directive User Community), een internationaal congres op het gebied van digitale weerbaarheid, cybersecurity en toezicht. Tijdens dit congres komen toezichthouders, overheden en professionals uit Nederland, België en Luxemburg samen om kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen rondom onder meer NIS2 en cybersecurity.

Als Projectleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en organisatorische aansturing van het congres en zorg je voor een succesvolle realisatie van het programma en de samenwerking met alle betrokken partijen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je voert de projectleiding over het volledige programma van NISDUC 2027.

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de organisatie van het internationale cybersecuritycongres.

  • Je ontwikkelt, beheert en vult de verschillende programmalijnen en tracks.

  • Je stemt af met betrokken overheidsorganisaties, toezichthouders en partners.

  • Je organiseert internationale kennisuitwisseling en samenwerking binnen het congresprogramma.

  • Je stuurt het betrokken evenementenbureau aan.

  • Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit, voortgang en resultaten van het congres.

  • Je draagt zorg voor een professioneel en inhoudelijk sterk programma rondom digitale weerbaarheid en cybersecurity


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als projectleider.

  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen het cybersecuritydomein.

  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het aansturen van de organisatie van inhoudelijke congressen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met complexe opdrachten en omvangrijke trajecten met een hoog afbreukrisico.

  • Je bent in het bezit van een projectmanagementcertificering.

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Je hebt ervaring als projectleider binnen de Rijksoverheid.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het organiseren van cybersecurity-events.

  • Je hebt ervaring met samenwerkingspartners binnen het cybersecuritydomein, zoals het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC).

Competenties

  • Je bent bestuurlijk sensitief.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk.

  • Je bent creatief in het ontwikkelen van programma’s en oplossingen.

  • Je beschikt over organisatiesensitiviteit.

  • Je weet verschillende belangen effectief samen te brengen.

  • Je begrijpt de dynamiek van een publieke organisatie en beweegt je gemakkelijk binnen een complexe stakeholderomgeving.

Informatie 

Start: 2 november 2026

Aantal uur: 16 tot 20 uur per week

Lengte opdracht: 8 maanden

Locatie: Amersfoort

Vorm: ZZP

Schaalniveau: 14

Geïnteresseerd?

Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 26 oktober 9.00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.

Contact

Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kunt u contact opnemen met Leonie van Hove, Managing Consultant Interim Management, 06 45 39 02 31, Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: C005491 Senior Engineer (Network) (NS) - MON 2 Nov
original_description:
Deadline Date: Monday 2 November 2026

Requirement: Senior Engineer (Network)

Location: Brunssum, NL

Full Time On-Site: Yes

Time On-Site: 100%

Total Scope of the request (hours): 270

Required Start Date: 7 December 2026

End Contract Date: 31 December 2026

Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET

 

Duties & Role: 

The Contractor shall perform activities related to the planning, design, implementation, integration, validation, and deployment of Core Services solutions across CIS environments. Services shall be delivered in a structured and controlled manner, ensuring alignment with project objectives, technical requirements, implementation schedules, and stakeholder expectations.

The scope includes the development of technical designs, installation and configuration of Core Services components, system integration, execution of testing and acceptance activities, support to deployment and migration efforts, and the production of all required technical documentation. The Contractor shall contribute to technical coordination, risk identification and mitigation, quality assurance, and project governance activities to ensure the successful delivery of CIS capabilities.

The Contractor shall work closely with project teams, architects, security stakeholders, and operational authorities to ensure that delivered solutions are fit for purpose, interoperable, secure, and capable of supporting current and future operational requirements.

The Contractor shall provide regular service reports detailing the status and progress of assigned CIS and DCIS project activities. Reports shall provide visibility of project execution, technical achievements, risks, issues, and planned activities to support effective project governance and decision-making.

The service reports shall include, as a minimum:

  • Progress against agreed project plans, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Status of design, integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and migration activities.
  • Achievement of key project objectives and technical deliverables.
  • Identification of project risks, issues, dependencies, and proposed mitigation actions.
  • Summary of completed activities during the reporting period.
  • Planned activities and milestones for the upcoming reporting period.
  • Status of technical documentation, design artefacts, and acceptance deliverables.
  • Quality assurance activities performed and any identified non- conformities.
  • Resource utilisation and effort expended against assigned tasks, where required.
  • Escalations, decisions, or support required from NCIA stakeholders.
  • Reports shall be delivered in accordance with NCIA reporting requirements and shall provide sufficient detail to enable effective monitoring of project performance, delivery progress, schedule adherence, and quality objectives.

Requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

  • The candidate must have a currently active NATO SECRET security clearance
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Engineering or a related discipline or an equivalent combination of education & professional experience.
  • 5 years' experience designing, implementing, operating, maintaining, troubleshooting enterprise & deployable network infrastructures.
  • Experience supporting on-premises CIS environments, including data centres, server rooms, command & control facilities & deployable communications systems.
  • Experience supporting Deployable CIS, including the deployment, configuration, operation, sustainment & recovery of network infrastructure in operational & expeditionary environments.
  • Experience integrating, testing & supporting fixed & deployable network architectures
  • Experience conducting network installations, upgrades, migrations & modernization activities for mission-critical systems.
  • Experience developing & maintaining network documentation, architecture diagrams, implementation plans, operating procedures & configuration baselines.
  • Experience performing fault isolation, root-cause analysis & performance optimization in complex operational environments.
  • Experience working within military, defence, government or other mission-critical operational environments is desirable.

The Contractor shall possess proven expertise/experience in several of the following areas:

  • Network Infrastructure: Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPN & related network services. Strong knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies. Experience with routing protocols including OSPF, BGP & EIGRP. Experience designing & implementing VLANs, network segmentation, QoS & traffic management solutions. Experience configuring & supporting enterprise-grade routing & switching platforms.
  • Deployable CIS: Experience deploying, configuring, operating & maintaining communications infrastructure in deployable & expeditionary environments. Knowledge of deployable network architectures, mobile communications platforms & field-deployable networking solutions. Experience supporting tactical, operational or mission-critical communications systems. Familiarity with deployable command-and-control communications environments & associated networking requirements. Experience supporting communications resilience, redundancy & continuity of operations in deployed environments.
  • Network Security: Experience implementing & maintaining secure network architectures. Knowledge of firewalls, intrusion detection & prevention systems (IDS/IPS), network access control (NAC), secure remote access solutions and encryption technologies. Experience applying cybersecurity principles & security controls to operational & deployable CIS environments. Familiarity with applicable security frameworks, standards & best practices for enterprise & deployable networks.
  • Network Operations & Support: Experience monitoring, maintaining & troubleshooting complex network environments. Ability to perform network diagnostics, fault isolation, root-cause analysis & corrective actions. Experience using network monitoring, performance management & troubleshooting tools. Experience supporting high-availability & mission-critical network services.
  • Network Design & Engineering: Experience designing, implementing & documenting network architectures and solutions. Ability to assess operational requirements & translate them into technical network designs. Experience planning & executing network upgrades, technology refreshes & infrastructure modernization activities. Knowledge of network resiliency, redundancy & disaster recovery.
  • Vendor Technologies: Experience configuring & supporting network equipment from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto & Fortinet or equivalent enterprise networking platforms.
  • Certifications: CCNP Enterprise & JNCIP-Enterprise

title: C005486 Senior Engineer (DevSecOps) (NS) - MON 2 Nov
original_description:
Deadline Date: Monday 2 November 2026

Requirement: Senior Engineer (DevSecOps)

Location: Brunssum, NL

Full Time On-Site: Yes

Time On-Site: 100%

Total Scope of the request (hours): 270

Required Start Date: 7 December 2026

End Contract Date: 31 December 2026

Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET

 

Duties & Role: 

The Contractor shall perform activities related to the planning, design, implementation, integration, validation, and deployment of DevSecOps solutions across CIS environments. Services shall be delivered in a structured and controlled manner, ensuring alignment with project objectives, technical requirements, implementation schedules, and stakeholder expectations.

The scope includes the development of technical designs, installation and configuration of DevSecOps components, system integration, execution of testing and acceptance activities, support to deployment and migration efforts, and the production of all required technical documentation. The Contractor shall contribute to technical coordination, risk identification and mitigation, quality assurance, and project governance activities to ensure the successful delivery of CIS capabilities.

The Contractor shall work closely with project teams, architects, security stakeholders, and operational authorities to ensure that delivered solutions are fit for purpose, interoperable, secure, and capable of supporting current and future operational requirements.

The Contractor shall provide regular service reports detailing the status and progress of assigned CIS and DCIS project activities. Reports shall provide visibility of project execution, technical achievements, risks, issues, and planned activities to support effective project governance and decision-making.

The service reports shall include, as a minimum:

  • Progress against agreed project plans, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Status of design, integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and migration activities.
  • Achievement of key project objectives and technical deliverables.
  • Identification of project risks, issues, dependencies, and proposed mitigation actions.
  • Summary of completed activities during the reporting period.
  • Planned activities and milestones for the upcoming reporting period.
  • Status of technical documentation, design artefacts, and acceptance deliverables.
  • Quality assurance activities performed and any identified non-conformities.
  • Resource utilisation and effort expended against assigned tasks, where required.
  • Escalations, decisions, or support required from NCIA stakeholders.

Requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

  • The candidate must have a currently active NATO SECRET security clearance
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering or a related discipline or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 5 years experience in DevSecOps, DevOps, software engineering, platform engineering or infrastructure automation roles.
  • Experience supporting on-premises CIS environments, including enterprise data centres, mission-critical infrastructure and operational systems.
  • Experience designing, implementing and maintaining DevSecOps pipelines and automation frameworks in secure, on-premises environments.
  • Experience integrating security controls and compliance requirements throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience supporting containerized and cloud-native technologies deployed in on-premises environments.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management and automated deployment solutions.
  • Experience working within military, defence, government or mission-critical operational environments is desirable.
  • Experience producing technical documentation, deployment procedures, architecture diagrams, security artefacts and operational handover documentation.

Expertise/experience in several of the following areas:

  • DevSecOps and CI/CD: Designing, implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. DevSecOps principles and practices, including secure software delivery and automated security testing. CI/CD platforms such as GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps or equivalent. Integrating automated build, testing, deployment and security validation processes.
  • Infrastructure as Code and Automation: Developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions. Tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet or equivalent. Automating infrastructure provisioning, configuration management and deployment processes. Scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar.
  • Containerization and Platform Technologies: Deploying and supporting containerized applications and services. Container technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes. Container security, image management and container lifecycle management. Platform engineering concepts and modern application deployment architectures.
  • Cybersecurity and Secure Development: Integrating security controls throughout the software development lifecycle. Secure coding practices, application security principles and software assurance methodologies. Implementing Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA) and vulnerability management processes. Implementing secrets management, identity and access management and secure configuration practices.
  • Systems and Infrastructure: Supporting Linux and Windows Server environments. Virtualization platforms and enterprise infrastructure technologies. Supporting application hosting platforms, middleware, databases and supporting infrastructure services.
  • Monitoring, Logging and Observability: Implementing monitoring, logging and observability solutions. Tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic or equivalent monitoring platforms. Performance monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting and operational reporting.

Certifications

The proposed contractor shall possess at least one of the following certifications:

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
  • Docker Certified Associate (DCA)
  • Equivalent industry-recognized DevOps, platform engineering or automation certification.

In addition, the contractor shall possess at least one cybersecurity-related certification:

  • CompTIA Security+
  • GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
  • ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
  • Equivalent industry-recognized cybersecurity certificate

title: Senior Front End Consultant (React)
original_description:
Leid complexe React-omgevingen naar een hoger niveau.
Als Senior Front-end Development Consultant bij Divotion ben jij inhoudelijk richtinggevend binnen React-trajecten. Je helpt organisaties met complexe front-end vraagstukken en tilt architectuur, schaalbaarheid en codekwaliteit naar enterprise-niveau.

Je combineert technische diepgang met adviesvaardigheden en neemt eigenaarschap in klantomgevingen waar performance, maintainability en lange termijn doorontwikkeling centraal staan.

Wat ga je doen?
Je werkt aan strategische React-trajecten bij klanten waar schaalbaarheid, performance en stabiliteit cruciaal zijn. Je fungeert als technisch sparringpartner voor zowel developers als stakeholders.

Concreet:

  • Ontwerpen en realiseren van enterprise-grade React-architecturen

  • Opzetten en bewaken van front-end standaarden en design systems

  • Implementeren van schaalbare state management-oplossingen (Redux, Zustand, etc.)

  • Adviseren over tooling, CI/CD, testingstrategie en performance-optimalisatie

  • Reviewen van code en coachen van collega-developers

  • Samenwerken met backend, UX en DevOps op architectuurniveau

  • Actief bijdragen aan knowledge sharing binnen Divotion (kennissessies, events)


Je past goed bij deze rol als je jezelf herkent in (een deel van) het onderstaande profiel:

  • HBO+/WO werk- en denkniveau

  • Minimaal 6 jaar ervaring als React Front-end Developer in complexe omgevingen

  • Diepgaande expertise in React (hooks, performance, architectuur)

  • Sterke ervaring met TypeScript en component-based development

  • Ervaring met moderne frameworks zoals Next.js (pré)

  • Ervaring met testing frameworks (bijv. Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Vitest, Cypress)

  • Ervaring met moderne build- en deployment pipelines

  • Affiniteit met cloud-omgevingen

  • Je communiceert helder en adviseert overtuigend

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Benefits

  • Salaris tot €6.000 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en senioriteit

  • Mobiliteitsbudget van €825 per maand of een leasebudget van €925

  • Bonus- en pensioenregeling

  • Mogelijkheid om 32–40 uur per week te werken

Ontwikkeling & inhoud

  • Uitgebreid persoonlijk ontwikkelprogramma (soft skills, coaching en inhoudelijke groei)

  • Trainingen en opleidingen op maat

  • Deelname aan conferenties, beurzen en kennissessies (o.a. Frontmania)

  • Projecten die aansluiten bij jouw technische interesses

Werkomgeving

  • Werken in een kleine, hechte groep waarin je collega’s echt leert kennen

  • Samenwerken met ervaren en inspirerende professionals

  • Innovatieve organisatie met minimale overhead en veel autonomie

  • Volop ruimte voor eigen initiatieven en ideeën

Cultuur & balans

  • Jaarlijks collega-weekend en events zoals de Fullstackathon

  • Veel aandacht voor balans, welzijn en werkplezier

CAO & arbeidsvoorwaarden
Conflux is aangesloten bij de Vereniging van Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN); op deze functie is de CAO voor Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN) van toepassing.

Over Divotion
Divotion is een gespecialiseerde IT-consultancy waar vakidioten met passie werken aan oplossingen die écht functioneren. We combineren technische excellentie met mensgericht werken en bouwen samen aan duurzame software én duurzame carrières. 
Wij verwelkomen talent met diverse achtergronden en nodigen iedereen uit om te solliciteren, ongeacht gender, achtergrond of andere kenmerken.



Heb je vragen over de vacature?
Neem contact op met Puck Schelstraete (Talent & Development Lead) via Interim Talent Acquisition Specialist) via +31 (0)6 40 87 55 89.

Hopelijk tot snel!

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
original_description:
Staff Software Engineer, Backend

 

About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We’re looking for Staff Software Engineers. You’ll join our Chat or Activity Feeds team and own backend systems that thousands of developers build their products on, from how they’re structured to how they scale.

This is a full-time role based in our Amsterdam (visa & relocation support possible), Toronto, or Skopje office. We are also open to hiring the right person remote from the EU.

About you

You’ve built backend systems at high scale and stayed long enough to live with your own decisions, good and bad. You care about how a system is structured, not only the next feature, and you can explain your trade-offs to the people who’ll live with them. Maybe you led a team for a few years and chose to go back to hands-on work. That’s welcome here: this is an individual contributor role, and you’ll write code and touch databases yourself. Our leads spend about 80% of their time hands-on too. You won’t enjoy it if you want to manage people, or if you’d rather stay away from infrastructure and database work.

We’re also hiring Senior Engineers on these teams. If your experience fits Senior better than Staff, we’ll say so openly and talk it through with you.

You have

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including technical leadership on systems in production.

  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or in another backend language plus the willingness to switch to Go.

  • Experience building features used by a large number of users, and scaling them as usage grows.

  • Strong experience with a relational database. We use PostgreSQL, but any relational database counts.

  • Hands-on experience with Redis or a similar in-memory data store.

  • Experience building public APIs or SDKs that other developers use.

  • Comfort with infrastructure and database work as part of your normal week, including Kubernetes.

  • Good written and spoken English. It’s our working language.

Bonus points

  • PostgreSQL in production at scale, including sharding, partitioning or large migrations.

  • Experience improving or redesigning legacy parts of a system that’s serving live traffic.

  • Go and gRPC in production at high request rates.

  • Messaging, feeds or other real-time systems, or message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.

  • Distributed storage internals, such as Raft or RocksDB.

  • You’ve cut infrastructure cost at a company where margins mattered.

  • Experience running workloads on GCP or AWS.

Don’t worry if you haven’t used every tool we run. You’ll get exposure to most of them, and you’re welcome to convince us to add your favorites.

What makes this role exciting

  • Scale: more than 1 billion end users and billions of API requests a month go through the systems you’ll own.

  • Impact: cost per message and query latency show up directly in our margins and in the apps of customers like Strava and Patreon.

  • Stack: Go, gRPC, RocksDB and Python; PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ; GCP and Kubernetes; Grafana, Prometheus, ELK (Elasticsearch and Kibana), Jaeger and Tempo for distributed tracing, and Datadog; Redis, Valkey and Memcached.

  • Starting point: you’ll ship to production in your first weeks and own a meaningful area within your first months.

What we offer

  • Generous compensation

  • Stock options

Amsterdam office benefits:

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays.

  • Pension plan with a company contribution.

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered by Stream.

  • EUR 500 per year for personal development.

  • Catered lunches in the office.

  • MacBook Pro.

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice.

  • Relocation support if you move to Amsterdam, including visa sponsorship as a recognised IND sponsor.

Toronto, Skopje and remote EU: local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Why join Stream?

We’re a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We’re backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We’ll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There’s no fixed playbook, you’ll own things end to end, and you’ll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That’s also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you’ll feel at home here.

 
 

Hybrid office policy: applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.

Equal opportunity employer statement: Stream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Note for external recruiters: We currently have this role covered and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant
original_description:
Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien.

Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging.

Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit.

Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties.

Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn.

In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken.


Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten:

Je hebt een sterke basis in;

  • Python

  • Cloud (AWS, GCP of Azure)

  • Data pipelines bouwen en ouderhouden (ELT/ ETL)

  • Data warehousing (Databricks, Snowflake of BigQuery)

  • Orchestratie (Airflow, Dagster)

  • Terraform, CI/ CD


Pluspunten, maar geen vereiste:

  • Streaming (Kafka, Spark, Flink)

  • DevOps (Kubernetes)

  • Data Governance en management (bijvoorbeeld dbt)

  • Ervaring met AI en of ML infrastructuur (feature stores, vector databases, ML pipelines)

Je hoeft niet alles te beheersen. Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en technische diepgang vinden we belangrijker dan een perfecte checklist.



Benefits

  • Salaris tussen €5.500 en €6.700 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en senioriteit

  • Vakantiegeld, 8%

  • Lease- en Mobiliteitsbudget van €925 per maand

  • Bonus- en pensioenregeling

  • 25 Vakantiedagen

  • Hybride werken: de juiste balans tussen thuis, kantoor en klant

  • Vrije keuze in laptop en telefoon

  • Ruimte voor kennisdeling, certificeringen en conferentiebezoek (haal die badge!)

  • Vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportactiviteiten en sociale events (vrijblijvend)

  • Uitdagende én leuke projecten bij aansprekende klanten

  • Een informele cultuur met ruimte voor initiatief en innovatie

CAO & arbeidsvoorwaarden
Conflux is aangesloten bij de Vereniging van Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN); op deze functie is de CAO voor Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN) van toepassing.

Over BigData Republic
BigData Republic is een high-end consultancybureau gespecialiseerd in data science, data engineering en machine learning. We zijn AI-native en combineren dit met diepgaande engineering kennis. Op deze manier bieden wij onze klanten technische begeleiding tot duurzame en innovatieve oplossingen. Als niche-consultancyteam onderscheiden we ons van de grote spelers: we leveren kwaliteit boven kwantiteit en willen een thought leader in ons vakgebied zijn. Voor onze klanten richten we ons op het creëren van businesswaarde met innovatieve datasolutions die een duurzame impact hebben. Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele pijlers van onze organisatie: elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogposts, organiseren meetups en bezoeken conferenties. Bij BigData Republic kun je dé expert in de ruimte zijn, en tegelijkertijd elke dag iets nieuws leren van je collega's.

Word onderdeel van BigData Republic
Wij verwelkomen talent met diverse achtergronden en nodigen iedereen uit om te solliciteren, ongeacht gender, achtergrond of andere kenmerken.

Interesse? Solliciteer eenvoudig via de Solliciteren-button.

Heb je vragen over de vacature?
Neem contact op met Puck Schelstraete (Talent & Development Lead) via Interim Talent Acquisition Specialist) via +31 (0)6 40 87 55 89.

Hopelijk tot snel!

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
